> **⚠️🔍⚠️ READ NEXT (2026-05-14, post-s073d — cat-4 same-polhode leg returns AMBIGUOUS, not clean pass/fail).** First decisive check in the s073c cat-4-conversion sequence landed. Truth and cluster_457 on seed 89 are on the same regime (A) with k² agreeing to 0.36% and polhode period T_pol agreeing to 0.82%, *but* the two scalar invariants that fully determine the polhode curve — 2T and |L|² — differ by **1.118%** and **1.112%** respectively, and the body-frame ω_body(t) traces are separated by **0.67% × |ω₀_truth|** in max nearest-neighbour set-distance (both directions, well above the 1e-15 propagator noise floor). Visually the two polhodes overlap; quantitatively they are nearby but geometrically distinct curves. **The s073 banner claim ("|L| match at 0.55% ⇒ same body-frame polhode, same 2T") was an unverified extrapolation** — computing 2T directly shows it differs at the same ~1.1% scale as |L|². Two readings of the result: (i) **strict** — different polhodes; cat-4 framing breaks for this seed; (ii) **charitable** — s059k LM polish minimised LC residual, not polhode distance, so a 1% polhode shift could be polish residual rather than a geometric distinction. We cannot distinguish (i) vs (ii) from this single pair. **Operational consequence:** cat-4 as originally stated ("exact same body-frame polhode, free inertial L direction") is *weakened*, not killed. The reframing direction is "*nearby* polhodes also fit at Band A on this seed", which is a different theoretical statement and overlaps with cat-3 (within-noise) more than s073 admitted. **Methodology lesson reinforced (memory: `feedback_dont_overclaim_from_one_data_point.md`)**: when a hypothesis hinges on two scalar invariants, measure both — don't extrapolate from one to the other. Truth and c457 also sit at very different *phases* on these near-coincident curves (truth ω₀ near ω_y≈+|ω|; c457 ω₀ near ω_x≈+|ω|, ~90° around the polhode). See `experiments/s073d_polhode_match_cluster457.md` for the full analysis, both interpretations, and the redirect logic.

> **⚠️📚⚠️ READ NEXT (2026-05-14, post-s073c — scope correction + literature novelty audit).** s073c re-scopes the s073 claims and confirms the framing is not in the published RSO LC inversion literature. **Two corrections to the s073 banner below:** (1) the "L-conservation cross-anchor matching IS a real discriminator" claim is overstated from N=1 — it should read "the L_J2000 direction of cluster_457 differs from truth by 128.6°, so an L-matching filter *would discriminate this pair if applied*; the filter itself is untested as a method on a candidate pool." Space Res.* 74:5619 §4 "The flip problem" + Burton 2024 Purdue PhD thesis §8.5 + §9.3.1 enumerate three ambiguity categories (flip / object visual symmetry / noise). The framing implied by s073 — body-frame-polhode-invariance ⇒ continuous L_J2000 family on bodies without shape symmetry — would be a fourth category, not present in the literature. **Zero occurrences of "polhode" in Burton's 234-page thesis.** Burton's Future Work doesn't enumerate this direction. **Note (post-s073d, 2026-05-14):** the s073d check found scalar invariants 2T/|L|² differ by ~1.1% — *not* the clean "same polhode" result the banner below assumes. See the s073d banner above for the corrected framing. **Robinson & Frueh 2025 *J. Astronaut. Sci.* ("Global LC Attitude Estimation with Noisy Measurements and Inertia Uncertainty"), DOI 10.1007/s40295-025-00557-9, is the remaining unread highest-threat paper — Springer paywall.** See `experiments/s073c_literature_novelty_audit.md` for the full audit, the four-category taxonomy, the cited quotes, and the original experiment plan. > **🚀🆕🚀 READ NEXT (2026-05-12) — JACOBI-ELLIPTIC CLOSED-FORM PROPAGATION DESIGN DOC (s062 phased plan; s062a done, s062b–d to go).** Torque-free Euler has a closed-form solution in Jacobi elliptic functions (Jacobi 1849). `src/dynamics/attitude_propagator.py::propagate_euler` integrates the same ODE numerically with DOP853, rtol=1e-10. **The closed form gives ω(t) via `scipy.special.ellipj` and q(t) via theta-function ratios (van Zon & Schofield 2007) or precession+nutation decomposition.** Two reasons this is load-bearing now: (1) the polhode-prior parameterization `(|L|, label, phase)` from `concepts/polhode_prior.md` IS the Jacobi parameterization — same DOF, dynamics-admissible by construction; (2) the s061 reframe (constant-ω propagation per (q_a, ω) candidate, brightness-filter every epoch) is propagator-bound at 100k–1M candidates × 500 epochs ≈ 14 h – 6 d via DOP853, **~8 min – 1.4 h via Jacobi (two orders of magnitude)**. Plus: drift-free, conserved quantities exact, no quaternion renormalization. Implementation queued as **s062a → s062d** under a **non-negotiable 3-gate validation** (q matches DOP853 to 1e-9 absorbing antipode; conserved 2T, L² constant in Jacobi to machine precision; renderer round-trip k1_body matches cached truth to 1e-12). Convention bug fix is recent — there is real risk of introducing a new convention bug in the q(t) implementation; the gate exists to catch it. **Do not implement in pieces without the gate. Do not sign-fudge.** Concept doc + math + references: `concepts/jacobi_propagation.md`. Phased implementation plan: `experiments/s062_jacobi_design.md`. Auto-memory: `project_jacobi_propagation_priority.md`. First sub-task is s062a — eigendecompose the m048 inertia into (I_1, I_2, I_3, R_pa) and validate Jacobi ω(t) against DOP853 on 5–10 seeds spanning the polhode regime distribution. R_pa is just a constant satellite-defined matrix composed once around the Jacobi core; "is I diagonal in the propagator's body frame" is a quick optimization check, not a precondition.

BUT truth-LINEAGE tracking decouples from spatial truth: random uniform tube sampling causes lineage tags to drift, so truth-cluster lineage descendants wander 100-150° from real truth even when SOME other cluster's lineage tracks truth at 1-5°.** Reframe for next round: (1) constant-ω propagation per (q_a, ω) candidate eliminates lineage drift, (2) polhode-prior tightens ω_max per-seed, (3) spatial-proximity truth identification (not lineage) — turns s061 from random-walk particle filter into candidate-trajectory enumerator. Headline next move: cohort validation across density-recoverable (s011), narrow-basin (s006/s010), and constraint-poor (s018a/b zero-classifiable) seed classes. > **🔥 READ ALSO (2026-05-07, post-s057g/h/i) — CLOUD-DATA ARCHITECTURE: forward-propagation discrimination at 4400× over null is a SEED GENERATOR, not a full inversion.** The s048c+ viewer's per-epoch quaternion clouds were mined as substrate for ω-direction priors via an 11-experiment series (s056, s056b, s057a-i). Direction (2) breathing-spectrum (s056) is dominated by mag_hifi (Pearson ρ=+0.78); not an independent signal channel. Direction (1) anchor-propagation: pivoted from per-pair metrics (failed; finite-diff at small geodesic distance is geometrically noisier than at large distance — s057f truth-q_a ranks LAST not first) to **forward-propagation** (s057g): for each (q_a, ω) candidate, propagate q_a forward via const-ω quaternion exponential to multiple validator epochs, score by weighted hits in survivor clouds. Discrimination ratio **4400× over null** ([22, 243] vs E[score]=0.04). Truth at top 10% by score, but body-twin canonicalisation (s057h) doesn't collapse the multi-solution pool — top clusters at qa_d_canon ≈ 175° are GENUINE alternates. Hi-fi validation (s057i) reveals back-prop amplification: ALL 16 rendered candidates (incl truth) are Band D because the +15% |ω| error in candidates compounds to ~107° accumulated rotation over 50-min back-propagation. Smoke test of EXACT truth back-prop gives ρ=0.65 (Band A) — the architecture is sound, but its candidates have local validity (~12 min window), not full-trajectory validity. **Operational role: seed generator that narrows search ~300× (100k Sobol → ~325 clusters); each candidate requires LM polish before ρ-band classification.** Headline next move: LM-polish 3-5 top cluster reps to test whether architecture seeds usable Band A∪B basins. See `experiments/s057g_forward_propagation.md` for the major finding, `experiments/s057i_hifi_validate.md` for the operational reframe.

> **🔥 READ FIRST (2026-05-07, post-s055a/b/c) — polhode prior is OPERATIONAL ON ω-MAGNITUDE ONLY: pol_diam (not D label) predicts basin width (s053) and is LC-recoverable at ~25% MAPE (s055a). L̂ direction + |cos(L̂,PAB)| + polhode-binary class are NOT LC-recoverable at the s008+PAB feature granularity (s055b, s055c). LC carries ω-magnitude info ✓, ω-direction info ✗.**
>
> **Architectural reframe surfaced from the s048c+ viewer.** The body-frame ω-direction sphere panel on seed 89 frame 499 shows ω̂(t) tracing a closed loop on the unit sphere — the polhode of torque-free rigid-body motion (intersection of the energy and momentum ellipsoids). Polhodes form a 1-parameter family of closed curves in body-frame ω-space, fully determined by the inertia tensor `I` (known a priori for m048 via `lib.hifi_render`).
>
> **The reframe (s051 + s053 sharpening + s055a confirmation):**
> - ω prior parameterized as `(|L|, polhode_label, polhode_phase)` rather than raw `(ω_x, ω_y, ω_z)` — same dimensionality, every sample dynamics-admissible.
> - **s053**: pol_diam (polhode L2 diameter, dps), NOT the label D, is the load-bearing basin-width predictor cohort-wide. Spearman ρ=−0.94 vs basin width on n=10, stronger than |ω| (ρ=−0.84). Operational rule: `δ|ω|/|ω| ≤ 0.5% × (pol_diam_ref / pol_diam_seed)` lands all 10 s042 seeds in basin under one bracket. Polhode topology cohort distribution: 13/100 enclose I_a, 87/100 enclose I_c, 50/100 near-separatrix.
> - **s055a**: pol_diam is LC-recoverable at 24.84% holdout MAPE (linear-direct, m048 100..119) — **factor-of-1.25 bracket-size error, well inside the s053 recoverability bound** (the rule tolerates 2× pol_diam error before broken). Top features: `dmag_mean_abs` + `acf_lag1` = 49% of RF importance — modulation rate × autocorrelation, physically what polhode amplitude predicts. |ω| LOO sanity control reproduces s008 within 0.65pp.
>
> **Operational implication**: the polhode prior compiles to a one-shot adaptive-bracket controller for ω-MAGNITUDE using LC-derived pol_diam estimates. **For ω-DIRECTION, the controller stays uniform on the sphere or polhode-tangent-constrained via the s053 reframe** — there is no LC-derived direction prior at this feature granularity. **s055d also closed cleanly**: cascade-pool pol_diam filter gives best enrichment 1.24× (well below 3× gate); the cascade's 17% ω-noise from anchor-pair finite-diff scrambles polhode invariants on truth-q_a hypotheses while letting random q_a's reproduce truth-like pol_diams by chance. **Path forward**: **s055e** = oracle adaptive-bracket pilot on holdout 100..119 with pol_diam from s055a (upper-bound the polhode-prior architecture given 25% pol_diam estimator quality) — highest-leverage remaining experiment. If s055e succeeds at cohort scale, cascade re-architecting (Phase 3 ω-noise reduction) may be unnecessary.
>

The same numerical data has been cached for months without seeding the reframe in any prior text-only session. For geometric/dynamic problems, build the viewer first.

**At N=400k Sobol, all 8 cohort seeds land in the s059i robust regime.** Seed 28 was an outlier (|C_a|=383 at N=100k, ~10× sparser survival cloud than other seeds), not representative — hence the s059_thread's misdiagnosis of a cohort-wide problem. **A1 (build s059j) is GO.**

Wrinkle from |C_a| variance: 1,473 (seed 28) to 29,940 (seed 84) at N=400k is a 20× spread. Naive joint (q_a × ω × 21-epoch-window) cost = |C_a| × 1407 × 21 ≈ 43M evals (seed 28, ~40s Pool(24)) → 880M (seed 84, ~14 min Pool(24)). **s059j needs |C_a|-cap subsampling** (cap ~3000 keeps closest-survive intact w.h.p.) **or seed-dependent ω-grid sizing** to keep wall budget bounded.

**Next move (handoff to next agent): build s059j per the design doc.** Design fully spelled out in `experiments/s059j_design.md`, including a user-proposed optimisation that makes anchor selection cheap.

**The user's anchor-selection optimisation (2026-05-08).** Separate "where to anchor" from "how dense at the anchor":
1. Coarse 50k pool projected at every epoch in [3, 30) → argmin |C_t| picks T_A in ~10 sec.
2. Dense 400k pool resampled at JUST T_A → q_a search set in ~3 sec.
Total cloud setup ~15 sec/seed vs the old "dense-at-all-500-epochs" cost of ~5 min Pool(8). **20× speedup with zero quality loss** — closest-to-truth in the survival cloud is set by pool density at the chosen anchor, which we densify regardless. The relative ranking of |C_t| across epochs is intrinsic to the LC, not a function of pool size, so coarse-argmin transfers cleanly to dense-anchor.

**Key design defaults (full table in `s059j_design.md`):**
- N_COARSE=50k, N_DENSE=400k, RNG_SEED=42, EARLY_WIN=[3, 30)
- |C_a| cap = 3000 (controls 20× wall variance from |C_a| spread across cohort)
- ω-grid: 200 dirs × 6 mags = 1200, ±30% mag bracket, polhode-prior |ω| centre
- Local window W=10 (matches s059e); top-K polish = 20-50
- LM polish on surrogate v2 (NOT hi-fi); hi-fi gate = surrogate ρ < 4
- **Hard rule: NO TRUTH-CLUSTER INJECTION in polish set.** Truth diagnostic separate.

**Per-seed wall ≈ 15-30 min Pool(24); cohort 8 seeds ≈ 2-4 hours.**

**Verification path:**
1. Run s059j on seed 28 first. Confirm Band A∪B yield without injection.
2. If yield ≥ 1, cohort-run on {6, 10, 14, 23, 28, 44, 84, 89}.
3. If yield = 0, localise the failure (q_a search-set sparse? ω grid coarse? polish budget tight?) and iterate.

**s057g/h/i (2026-05-07) — FORWARD-PROPAGATION DISCRIMINATION on cloud-data architecture works at 4400× over null, but is a SEED GENERATOR not a full inversion.** Major architectural finding from the 11-experiment s056-s057 cloud-data series. The s048c+ viewer's per-epoch quaternion clouds were mined as substrate for ω-direction priors. Three-direction sketch: (1) cross-epoch ω-aggregation, (2) |C_t|(t) breathing-spectrum, (3) cloud-centroid drift. Direction (2) closed by s056/s056b: |C_t|(t) is dominated by mag_hifi (Pearson ρ=+0.78), residual peaks at rotation harmonics already extractable from LC peak-spacing. Direction (1) explored across s057a-i: single-anchor pilot (s057, 1.79× concentration), Δt sweep (s057d, optimum at Δt=3 with 3.87× concentration), per-q_a centroid consistency (s057f, STRUCTURAL FAILURE — finite-diff at small geodesic distance is geometrically noisier than at large geodesic distance, so truth-q_a ranks LAST not first), pivot to **forward-propagation** (s057g): for each candidate (q_a, ω), propagate q_a forward via const-ω quaternion exponential to multiple validator epochs, score by weighted hits in survivor clouds. **Result**: scores [22, 243] vs null E[score] = 0.04 → **discrimination ratio 4400×**. Truth at top 10% by score (rank 55/548). Smoke test: const-ω propagation reliable to ±50 epochs (~6 min) on seed 89 despite near-separatrix dynamics. Body-twin canonicalisation (s057h) does NOT collapse the truth signal — top clusters are GENUINELY different multi-solution alternates (qa_d_canon ≈ 175°, NOT body-twins of truth). 548 candidates → 325 clusters; truth at rank 107 by sum-score, ~10-15 by max-score. **Hi-fi validation (s057i) reframes operationally**: ALL 16 rendered cluster reps Band D (truth ρ=44). Smoke test confirms back-prop of EXACT truth gives Band A (ρ=0.65). Killer is the +15% |ω| error in candidates being amplified over 50-min back-propagation: ~107° accumulated rotation deviation. **Architecture finds (q_a, ω) consistent over local validator window (~12 min); not a full-trajectory inversion**. Operational role: SEED GENERATOR — narrows search space ~300× (100k Sobol → ~325 clusters), each requiring LM polish to refine before ρ-band classification.

**Forward path** (priority order):
- **LM polish 3-5 top clusters** from s057g/h: scipy `least_squares` on full hi-fi LC cost surface, starting from each cluster representative's back-propagated (q_0, ω_0). If ≥1 lands in Band A∪B → architecture is genuinely operational as seed generator. ~5-10 min/cluster. **Highest-leverage immediate next step.**
- **Local-window ρ test**: render top clusters over [t_a-50, t_a+50] only (skip back-prop, integrate forward + backward from t_a within local window). Should give truth Band A and top alternates Band A∪B if architecture is locally valid. Cheap (~2 min). Diagnostic confirmation that the architecture's "validity over local window" claim is real.
- **s055e oracle adaptive-bracket pilot on holdout 100..119** (deferred from prior session, still high-priority): independent track — tests upper-bound of the |ω|-only polhode-prior architecture via direct sampling, bypassing the seed generator question. ~6-10h Pool(4).
- **Closed-now-clearly**: don't re-propose per-pair angular-distance metrics; don't revisit per-q_a centroid consistency on near-separatrix seeds (geometric structural failure). The forward-propagation route is the right shape; refinements should add LM polish or chained validation, not new pair metrics.

**s055d (2026-05-07) — cascade-pool pol_diam filter on s049 seed-14 pool also WEAK (best enrichment 1.24×, well below 3× gate). The polhode prior is OPERATIONAL ONLY on |ω| via s055a adaptive bracket — neither ω-direction priors (s055b/c) nor cascade-pool truth-discrimination (s055d) are recoverable.** Each (q_a, ω) hypothesis in the cached cascade pool implies a polhode (Euler-integrated body-frame ω(t) for 1h, max pairwise L2 distance = pol_diam). Filter rejects hypotheses whose implied pol_diam disagrees with LC-predicted pol_diam (s055a rf-log10 seed 14 LOO = 1.819 dps; truth 1.969 dps, LC error 7.7%). **Two scenarios both close**: (A) pol_diam-only on raw 141k pool: enrichment 0.87-1.02× flat across thresholds. (B) K=3 ∩ pol_diam: best 1.24× at 25% threshold; at 10-15% threshold ANTI-enriching (0.30×/0.76×). **Mechanism**: truth-q_a survivors (n=30, median pol_diam 1.37 dps) and full pool (n=39591, median 1.79) overlap heavily — cascade ω = `log(q_b · q_a^-1)/Δt` is anchor-pair-geometry-dominated, not truth-q_a-discriminating. Bug caught + fixed: cascade.npz `om_kept` is RAD/S not DPS despite variable name; first run gave pol_diam 57× too small. **Closes the s050 series + s055d cleanly**: every LC-derived re-aggregation of the cached cascade pool fails (mag-agreement / Hough / consensus / q-space / pol_diam). **Information bottleneck = 17% ω-noise of finite-diff anchor-pair derivation**, not choice of post-cascade filter.

**Forward path** (sharpened by all of s055a/b/c/d):
- **s055e — oracle adaptive-bracket pilot on holdout 100..119 with pol_diam from s055a** is the highest-leverage remaining experiment. Tests upper-bound of polhode-prior architecture given pol_diam estimator quality, on truly held-out data. ~6-10h Pool(4). Likely best move next.
- **Cascade architecture rethink**: needs Phase 3 ω-noise reduction (multi-pair averaging, peak-stationarity `∇B(q_peak)·ω=0` at LC extrema) OR abandon cascade in favour of s011-class joint q × ω architecture under pol_diam-adaptive bracket. **s055e tests the latter** — if s055e succeeds at cohort scale, cascade re-architecting may be unnecessary.
- **Closed-now-clearly**: don't propose any further "filter X on the cached cascade pool" experiments. The 17% noise floor washes out every LC-derived signal tested.

**s053 (2026-05-07) — POLHODE DIAMETER (not label D) is the load-bearing predictor of s042 ω-mag basin width — STRONGER than |ω| itself.** All 100 m048 seeds, sequential 3.89s wall. Per-seed (|L|, 2T, D=2T·I_b/|L|², pol_diam=max pairwise L2 on body-frame ω(t), |ω|_std/mean, cone_max). **Cohort topology**: 13/100 enclose I_a (D<1), 87/100 enclose I_c (D>1), **50/100 near-separatrix (|D-1|<0.05)** — m048 heavily skews toward high-inertia/near-symmetric axis (consistent with prolate body, I_b/I_c=0.992). |ω| std/mean uniformly tiny (0–0.57%). pol_diam spans 0.05→2.75 dps (52× variation). **s042 cross-correlation (n=10) Spearman ρ vs basin width**: |ω| ρ=-0.84 p=0.003 (the s042 finding); D ρ=+0.11 p=0.77 (NOT correlated); |D-1| ρ=+0.11 p=0.77 (NOT correlated); cone_max ρ=-0.11 p=0.77 (not alone); **pol_diam ρ=-0.94 p<0.001 (strongest)**. **Refines s051 sharply**: polhode label D does NOT predict basin width cohort-wide (the s051 mechanism was wrong); polhode DIAMETER does, mechanism `pol_diam ≈ |ω|·2·sin(cone_max/2)` combining |ω| scale and angular extent. Polhode reframe survives, with a different operative scalar. **Direct architectural implication**: adaptive bracket step `δ|ω|/|ω|` ∝ 1/pol_diam right-sizes per-seed search density; concretely `0.5%·(pol_diam_seed14/pol_diam_seed)` would land all 10 s042 seeds in basin under one scheme. Sample seeds: 14: |ω|=1.23, pol=1.97, basin 0.5% (largest polhode → narrowest basin); 42: |ω|=0.13, pol=0.05, basin 10% (tiny polhode → wide basin); 19: |ω|=1.48, pol=1.57, basin 3.0% (high |ω| but smaller polhode → wider basin than seed 14 — pol_diam predicts where |ω| fails). See `experiments/s053_cohort_polhode_survey.md`, `results/s053_cohort_polhode_survey/cohort_polhode_survey.png`.

**s052 (2026-05-07) — POLHODE-PRIOR CANNOT RESCUE THE s049 CASCADE POOL on seed 14 (three diagnostics, viewer-driven).** Three independent geometric tests, each via static viewer + matplotlib + image read-back: **(1) Polhode overlay** — truth polhode is a substantial closed curve in body-frame ω-space (1.97 dps L2 pairwise diameter, ~105° great-circle arc on the |ω|=1.235 sphere), NOT a point; cascade pool ~1.86 dps p90 from centroid is comparable in size. **(2) Tangent-projection retest** — projecting truth-qa onto nearest polhode point reduces error to ω_truth_t0 by p50 23% only (1.61→1.53 dps); projected hypotheses distribute around the *entire* polhode at random phase, not concentrated near truth phase. Modest, not structural. **(3) Polhode-label preservation** — `D_truth = 1.0885` confirms s051's prediction that high-|ω| seeds are near-separatrix, BUT cascade truth-qa hypotheses span `D ∈ [0.996, 1.367]` p10/p90, freely crossing separatrix; concentration enrichment over pool: 1.49× at ±0.001, 1.33× at ±0.01, **1.0× at ±0.05**. |L| varies 2× across truth-qa (truth=660, span 305-1183 kg m²/s). **Cascade noise is large enough to occupy multiple polhodes simultaneously; downstream polhode constraints (projection, label-filter, |L|-filter) cannot recover truth.** **REFINES BUT DOES NOT REFUTE s051**: polhode prior remains viable for *upstream* applications — direct (q_a, |L|, polhode_label, polhode_phase) sampling, LM-polish ω-tangent constraint, LC-derived polhode-period extraction — but NOT as a cascade-pool filter. Inertia tensor for m048: I_a=7749, I_b=37985, I_c=38306 kg·m² (I_b/I_c=0.992 near-prolate; I_c/I_a=4.94 strong asymmetry). All three findings surfaced from rendered figures + headless-Chrome image read-back. Wall total <15s. See `experiments/s052_polhode_overlay.md`, `results/s052_polhode_overlay/{overlay.html, diagnostic.png, projection_test.png, polhode_label_test.png, polhode.npz}`.

**Open paths (use polhode prior upstream, not as cascade filter):**
- (a) Cohort polhode survey — compute `D_seed = 2T·I_b/|L|²` for all 100 seeds, cross-correlate with s042 measured basin widths. ~30s wall. Tests s051's cohort-wide prediction.
- (b) Polhode-conditioned direct sampling — replace uniform `(ω_x, ω_y, ω_z)` Sobol with `(|L|, polhode_label, polhode_phase)` grid. Sample-efficiency study, no cascade dependency.
- (c) LM-polish tangent constraint — keep ω updates on polhode tangent during local descent at near-truth ω. 1-DOF instead of 3-DOF.
- (d) LC → polhode period τ_p extraction via Lomb-Scargle on |ω|(t) or quasi-periodic LC content. Independent of cascade.
- (e) C2 (peak-stationarity at LC extrema) from the prior agenda — last viable Phase 3 candidate after s050c/d/e closed C1.

**s050c/d/e (2026-05-07) — C1 (multi-pair concentration) CLOSED NEGATIVE across three structurally-distinct variants: Hough voting (s050c), distinct-t_k consensus (s050d), q-space agreement at validation (s050e).** Tested all three structurally-natural ways to extract truth from the s049 cascade pool by per-q_a aggregation. **Hough voting (max-bin-count over 3D ω-grid)** at K=5/bins=100 gives truth-q_a rank #1/1113 but the absolute concentration (4 vs pool p50=3) is barely above noise — fragile signal. **Distinct-t_k consensus** saturates at K/2 with 778-1099 ties at every (K, bins) tested — the metric collapses; larger K *reduces* discrimination because looser scan epochs flood the histogram. **Q-space agreement** (propagate cascade hypothesis to K=5 t_k's, find nearest q_b in Q_k, score by mean angular distance) gives best truth-q_a hypothesis ranks 2098/141706 (top 1.5%); top-1000 enrichment = 0.00× at every N tested up to 5000; **q-space score at top-10000 = 0.37× vs mag-only 1.11× — q-space is WORSE than mag-only**. **Unifying mechanism**: at the cascade's 17% ω-noise level, propagation drift over a few Δt produces predicted q-positions whose distance to Q_k is ~comparable for truth and random hypotheses. Per-q_a aggregation can't extract truth because the truth-adjacent q_b in Q_k contributes 1 vote drowned in ~|Q_k|−1 random; per-(q_a, ω) hypothesis can't because the cascade pool of 141k has many random coincidences in q-space too. **The information bottleneck is the Q_k density × pool size, not the validation metric — re-aggregating the existing pool can't help.** This closes the prompt's "multi-pair averaging" formulation (info-equivalent in this form). **C2 (peak-stationarity at LC extrema, ∇B(q_peak)·ω = 0) remains the last viable Phase 3 candidate** — no finite-diff, no per-q_b averaging, geometric-not-statistical discriminator. Compute estimate ~10 min quick test, ~25-30 min full pipeline if positive. See `experiments/s050cde_c1_concentration_dead.md`, `results/s050{c,d,e}_*/`.

**s050b (2026-05-07) — Path B (validation-step stress test) CLOSED NEGATIVE: no filter design on the s049 cascade pool concentrates truth.** Tested 100+ filter variants over four design axes: cached re-score grid (tol × K-subset over 5 cached val_eps), continuous-score top-N rankings (sum / max / inv-Δk-weighted / MSE), bright-epoch validation (added Δk=±13,±14,±15 fresh-computed via const-ω propagation + v1 surrogate, ~1.5s each), and per-q_a ranking (1113 distinct q_a's by best-ω fit quality). **Maximum enrichment achieved across all filters = 5.98× (1 truth-qa survivor in 155, statistically n.s.); next-best 2.87× (2/645). All other ~100 configurations enrichment ≤ 1.5×, most at or below random baseline.** **The diagnostic plot** `phase2_dmag_distributions.png` shows pool vs truth-q_a |Δmag| histograms are visually indistinguishable at every one of the 10 validation epochs tested. At the closest cached eps (Δk=+1,−2,+2): truth-qa p10 |Δmag| (0.031–0.039) is *higher* than pool p10 (0.014–0.021) — random hypotheses give better mag-fits at p10 than truth-qa does. **Per-q_a ranking is also dead**: truth-q_a's best ω hypothesis ranks 516–958 of 1113 distinct q_a's across 7 score variants — bottom 46–86%. **Mechanism**: cascade ω-noise of 17% causes ~1.5°·Δk drift in propagated q at val_eps, and surrogate mag prediction at the drifted q is ~comparable to mag prediction at a random q. **The validation step has no information content beyond "plausible mag at K nearby epochs."** **Phase 3 (ω-noise reduction) is now mandatory.** Two specific candidates: multi-pair averaging (derive ω from N anchor pairs per q_a, average to reduce noise by √N — could give a per-q_a confidence score that separates truth from coincidence) and peak stationarity (∇B(q_peak)·ω = 0 at LC extrema, gives ω-direction without finite-diff). Phase 1b (LM convergence probe) remains paused. See `experiments/s050b_validation_stress.md`, `results/s050b_validation_stress/{phase2_pareto.png, phase2_dmag_distributions.png, summary.json}`.

**s050a (2026-05-07) — Phase 1a cluster geometry on s049 cascade survivors: PHASE 2 GATE FAILS BY 163×.** The 35,835 survivors at tol=0.10/K=3 are structurally close to a uniform thinning of (q_a, ω) space, not a truth-concentrated cloud. p10/p50/p90 q-distance to actual truth = 15.86° / 129.42° / 173.24° (random-SO(3) median ~123°); ω-vector error p10/p50/p90 = 59% / 123% / 203%. Only **7 of 35,835** survivors satisfy both q < 5° AND ω-vec err < 30%. **Truth-q_a enrichment factor 0.59×**: 23 of 153 truth-q_a hypotheses survive vs 38.7 expected if the filter were a uniform 25.3% thinning — the filter is mildly *anti-*correlated with truth-q_a, not enriching for it. **Cluster decomposition (post `lib.twin.canonical_batch`)**: **32,640 clusters at default (5°/5%)**, 12,387 at (10°/10%), 1,779 at (20°/20%) — far above Phase 2's 200-cluster gate. Singletons / 2-3 element clusters dominate at every LM-relevant radius. **Phase 2 as planned (cluster + LM-polish-each-rep) is gated out**: 32,640 cluster reps × ~45s/polish = 24 hours/seed Pool(1), or 3 hours Pool(8), well over the 12-min LM stage budget. **The s049 framing missed three things**: (1) "truth survives" ≠ "truth is selected"; (2) the K=3 mag-agreement filter at LOCAL dim epochs (mag 14.69-14.76 dim window) is structurally loose — passes ~25% of (q_a, ω) hypotheses regardless of truth proximity; (3) truth-q_a hypotheses are slightly under-represented, not over-represented. **The cascade is currently a uniform thinner of (q_a, ω) space, not a seed generator for LM polish.** **Phase 1b paused pending user direction.** Next moves on the table: stress-test validation (tighter tol / brighter validation epochs / K-window choices); Phase 3 ω-noise reduction (multi-pair averaging, peak-stationarity at LC extrema); or run Phase 1b anyway to characterise LM's q-basin tolerance to ω-noise on hand-picked truth-adjacent survivors. See `experiments/s050a_cluster_geometry.md`, `results/s050a_cluster_geometry/{summary.json, phase1a_geometry.png, phase1a_cluster_counts.png}`.

**s049 (2026-05-07) — CASCADE ARCHITECTURE WORKS on seed 14 (high-|ω| retest of s048).** This is the architectural breakthrough — replaces the previously-infeasible "ω grid + cell pruning" pipeline with a derivation-based ω-hypothesis primitive. No ω grid, no cell-filter ranking, no LS-peak prior. **Single-thread wall 340s on seed 14**; cohort projection ~10–17 hr Pool(8) for 100 seeds (vs ~90 hr for Sobol+LM-everywhere).

Architecture: v1 anchor scan (30 dimmest epochs) → pick t_0 = argmin |C_t|, t_1 = tightest neighbour → derive ω hypotheses from (Q_0 × Q_1) via finite-diff `(q_b ⊗ q_a^{-1}) / Δt` → filter to cohort ω bounds → multi-epoch consistency filter at K validation epochs from LOCAL window (|kΔt| ≤ 10), tightest |C_t| first. Validation by mag-agreement at downstream epochs (no s048-style ω-agreement threshold).

**Headline numbers on seed 14 (|ω|=1.229 dps, the cohort Q4 binding case):**
- 141,706 raw (q_a, q_b) hypotheses (in cohort ω bounds, after 5.4% filter from 2.6M raw)
- **Truth-q_a (sample-res-bound at 1.39° from actual truth) survives at every (tol≥0.10, K=2-3) with q_dist=0°, |Δω|/|ω|=16.82%** — exactly the predicted sample-resolution noise floor
- **At tol=0.15/K=3 the cascade-truth ω hypothesis itself survives all 3 validation epochs**
- Decimation: 35,835 at tol=0.10/K=3 (25%), 472 at tol=0.10/K=5 (0.33%), 2,157 at tol=0.15/K=5 (1.5%)

**The cascade is a SEED GENERATOR for LM**, not a basin-finder. ω-noise of 17% is outside seed 14's 0.5%/2% ω-mag basin but inside LM's q-basin tolerance (s042: ≥25° on every seed). Survivor LM polish on truth-adjacent seeds should land Band A. The architecture also naturally handles multi-solution (each survivor cluster is an independent (q, ω) candidate to polish).

**Critical fixes vs s048**: (1) v1 surrogate (12× faster); (2) anchor selection by smallest |C_t|, not just brightest peak; (3) validation by mag-agreement at downstream epochs, NO ω-agreement threshold (that was s048's truth-rejection mechanism); (4) validation epochs LOCAL to anchor (Δk ≤ ±10 not global-tightest at Δk = -95). Initial s049 run with global-tightest validation eps reproduced s048's truth-fail at every (tol, K) — propagation drift over ~95 Δt's exceeds any C_t cloud at 17% noise. Local validation fixes it.

**Forward path** (next experiment, s050-class): clustering + LM polish on s049 survivors. Cluster the 35k survivors at tol=0.10/K=3 in (q_a, ω) space → ~hundreds of distinct seeds → joint LM polish on cluster reps → cluster Band A∪B distinct attractors → hi-fi confirm. Apply `lib.twin.canonical` at clustering to dedupe body-twin pairs.

See `experiments/s049_cascade_seed14.md`, `experiments/s048_peak_cascade_smoke.md`, `experiments/s048b_per_epoch_spread_v1.md`.

**s048 / s048b (2026-05-07) — peak-cascade smoke test on seed 89: per-epoch C_t pre-image works as a q-prior, cascade Tier-1 truth-survival fails at low |ω|.** User reformulation: filter random q on SO(3) per epoch via the surrogate against measured mag, yielding a manifold-restricted q-prior tighter than uniform Sobol. Confirmed mechanically — at seed 89's brightest peak (mag 5.38) 396/500k = 0.08% survive at tolerance 0.10 mag, truth-q within 0.5° of nearest survivor. Across 30 evenly-spaced epochs |C_t| varies 60× (1.3k–75k); across the 30 dimmest (mag 14.6–14.92) |C_t| splits into temporally-clustered "rare-geometry" windows (epoch 208 mag 14.92 → 384 survivors, comparable to brightest peak) and other dim epochs at 50k+ survivors. **Brightness alone does NOT predict selectivity; geometry does.** Cascade Tier-1 failed because finite-difference ω inference from `(q_a, q_peak, q_b)` triples is noise-amplified at low |ω|: at seed 89's |ω|=0.24 dps, per-dt rotation (1.7°) is comparable to discrete-sample noise (~1.5° at 500k samples on SO(3)) → inferred ω has O(100%) noise vs truth. v1 surrogate ~12× faster than v2 (4.5 vs 56 μs/sample); 30-epoch sweep at 500k samples = 144 sec wall on v1. **Both v1 and v2 expose the same `predict_magnitude` API** — v1 imported directly from `surrogate_model.surrogate_v1`, v2 wrapped by `lib/surrogate_eval.py`. User intuition surfaced: |C_t|(t) cloud appears to "breathe" (expand/contract) periodically across the LC, possibly carrying ω-related frequency content; flagged dead-class concern (`feedback_lc_spectral_omega_prior_dead.md`) but cloud-size is mechanism-different from spectral peak-spacing. **Next: s048c viewer shipped — user dispatches sweeps from the browser; cloud-breathing periodicity quantification (FFT of `|C_t|(t)`) becomes a cheap follow-up once visual confirms the hypothesis.** See `experiments/s048_peak_cascade_smoke.md`, `experiments/s048b_per_epoch_spread_v1.md`, `experiments/s048c_handoff.md`, `experiments/s048c_cloud_viewer.md`.

**s047b (2026-05-07) — cell-filter ranking GATE FAILS on s019 high-density bracket.** Pre-flight test for the s047 hybrid pilot ran 25.9 min Pool(8) on seed 14's full 97-cell bracket: **closest-to-truth cell ranks 34/97 under `max_geo`, 59/97 under `max_align`, 81/97 under `n_pass_both`**. Failure mechanism is filter-score saturation — `max_geo == 1.0` on the top 33 cells, `max_align == 1.0` on the top 41. The s047a "top-1=72% / top-2=97%" headline was gross-mismatch elimination on s032's 5-cell bracket (where 4/5 cells were obvious far-from-truth); on s019's 97-cell bracket where many cells sit 1–3% from truth, the metric collapses. **The "rank cells by filter, densify top-K" architecture proposed in s046's forward path is broken at the densities the cohort actually requires.** Forward path that survives: bypass cell-filter ranking; take ω-cell candidates from the s019 LS-significant peaks directly (spectrally-informed prior, no ranking step), with local fine-cell densification at basin width (0.5%) around each peak. The s047 hybrid pilot draft was revised post-result along this path: LS peaks → 5 fine cells × 0.5% step → Sobol q0 hemisphere via `lib.twin.canonical_batch` → LM polish (surrogate-MSE objective) → cluster Band A∪B → hi-fi confirm. **Three architectural concerns surfaced and addressed in the redraft**: (A) strict ≥1.0 geo filter throws out near-truth candidates (s039a cohort-cached confirmation: seed 1 strict_1.0 = 4 cands within 15° basin → half_0.5 = 293 cands; concern resolved by removing the filter); (B) binary align cost is information-destructive vs continuous surrogate-MSE on polished candidates (resolved by using surrogate-MSE for ranking); (C) N_phi (q0) overweighted vs N_dir (ω-direction) when q0 basin is 25–60° and ω-dir basin is 0.5°–7° (resolved by Sobol N=32 hemisphere q0 + Fibonacci N=8 ω-dirs per fine cell). See `experiments/s047b_seed14_full_bracket_cell_filter.md`, `experiments/s047_hybrid_pilot.py` (draft, not yet run).

**Sizing risk to validate before running s047 pilot**: the draft places 5 fine cells × 0.5% step around each LS peak (covers ±1% per peak). Seed 14's nearest s019 *bracket cell* sits 2.27% off truth; whether seed 14 has any LS *peak* within ≤1% of truth is the load-bearing precondition for the seed-14 pilot landing in the 0.5% basin. 1-second sanity check on cached LS peaks before committing compute.

**s046 (2026-05-06) — s019 LS-bracket post-fix re-scored against s042 basin rule.** The "98/100 within 5%" s019 headline overstates basin coverage by ~2×: under the conservative cohort scaling rule (c=1%/a=0.5), the s019 bracket covers only **54/100** seeds within basin; under lenient (c=2%/a=1.0): 75/100. **|ω|-stratified pass rate decays sharply on the fast tail**: Q1 (slowest) 24/25 → Q4 (fastest) 5/25 under conservative rule. Bracket offset ~1.25% p50 is roughly constant; basin shrinks ~3× from Q1 (2.14%) to Q4 (0.87%). See `experiments/s046_s019_bracket_basin_coverage.md`.

**s043 (2026-05-06) — body-twin LC equivalence verified BIT-EXACT in hi-fi.** Truth and twin LCs are identical to within 2.29e-08 mag (cohort max across seeds 23, 28, 89), six orders of magnitude below the 0.05 mag noise floor. The body-twin map is operationally exact, NOT just close. **Search-space deduplication via canonical hemisphere selection is safe and lossless** — `canonical(q0, ω)` is now in `lib.twin` (s044) and ready to apply at every search stage. Future basin probes can drop the twin column routinely. See `experiments/s043_twin_hifi_verify.md`.

**s042 (2026-05-06) — joint-LM basin radius cohort probe on 13 |ω|-stratified seeds × {truth, twin}.** See `experiments/s042_basin_radius_cohort.md`.

13-seed cohort = s040 (23, 28, 89) + s042 (79, 57, 62, 6, 14, 19, 84, 16, 42, 44). Stratification: 6 |ω|-quantile reps (q10-q90), 4 multi-solution / narrow-basin candidates. q0 grid extended to {2..60}° per s041 finding. 780 + 210 = 990 LMs total. Pool(8) wall 36.3 + 9.4 = 45.7 min.

**Three load-bearing findings**:

1. **Truth/twin basins are reflection-symmetric on 12/13 seeds.** Only seed 89 carries a q0-perp asymmetry (5° / 20°), driven by a competing class_2 attractor near truth. Body-twin convention is NOT a generic asymmetry source.

2. **ω-mag basin width inversely correlates with |ω|.** Strong cohort signal:
   - Low |ω| (<0.25 dps, n=5): basin ±10% saturated.
   - Mid |ω| (0.25–0.75, n=4): ±5% mean.
   - High |ω| (>0.75, n=4): ±3% mean, with **seed 14 +0.5%/−2% the tightest** and seed 44 ±1%, seed 28 +2/−3% confirming s011's narrow-basin class.
   
   **Cohort-scaling rule**: required ω-mag prior ≈ `1-2% / |ω|_dps^(0.5..1)`.

3. **Seed 14 surfaces a previously-uncatalogued multi-solution attractor at ρ=2.78 (Band B), q0_err=86°, ω-dir=0.37°, ω-mag=+0.541%**. Not on s014b's list. Multi-solution acceptance saves seed 14 (both truth ρ=0.28 and the multi-sol ρ=2.78 are admitted).

**Architectural takeaway for the cohort pipeline**: ω-prior tightness is the **1st-order cohort variable**; binding constraint = seed 14's 0.5% / 0.5° basin. q0 IC density is **2nd-order** (basins universally ≥25°-60°; LM globally convergent in q0 at correct ω). **Multi-solution acceptance is necessary for the high-|ω| tail.**

### Step 3 decision — diagnosis, NOT scaling

- **Bracket bin 0 at +4.6% off truth places truth at the edge of the s003 ω-mag tube** (~±2-5%). Per s003: outside this tube, surrogate-MSE landscape is incoherent and per-cell q0-best lands at 100°-180° from truth. The bracket misses the tube on seed 6, so no q0 candidate at any phi-sweep density lands inside-basin from ω-cell-0.
- **30° phi-step IC granularity is too coarse** to land basin candidates above align=0.429. Densifying alone doesn't help — basin candidates at ω-cell-0 are still outside the s003 tube.
- **Missing LM polish does not help in the off-tube regime.** Per s003: per-cell q0-best provides no gradient toward truth-ω from outside the tube. LM only converges from inside the tube (s005).

**Available next steps (NONE auto-pursued; awaiting user direction):**

1. **Switch IC primitive at ω-cell-0** — Sobol-Shoemake on q0 inside the bracket bin tube, accept that this means N≥1k cands per cell × 5 cells. Untested post-fix; doesn't address tube-boundary structurally.
2. **Densify the bracket** — push from 5 LS peaks to a denser ω-mag grid (e.g. ±1% steps within the LS-peak neighborhood). Doubles wall, may bracket the tube on cohort if seeds vary. s019 reported 98/100 cohort coverage within 5% — seed 6 is in the marginal tail.
3. **Joint q0×ω LM at every IC** instead of filter→LM. Reframes the architecture: filter becomes a ranking heuristic, LM is the workhorse. Wall ~hours/seed pending re-design.
4. **Accept the seed 6 negative as cohort-class evidence**: seeds where the bracket misses the tube boundary may simply be unsolvable by the s020 architecture. Run s019b cohort coverage + s003 tube width across the cohort to identify the recoverable subset.
5. **Multi-solution acceptance fallback**: even off-tube candidates may explain the LC at Band A∪B. s031 says NO for seed 6 (predicted ρ ≥ 28 is structural; outside the s003 tube the LCs simply don't match), so this fallback is unavailable on seed 6.

The user's morning-2026-05-04 reframe: alignment cost & geo cost are NECESSARY-CONDITION FILTERS, not optimisation targets. **The s021-s027 discovery suite (2026-05-04) confirms the framework decisively.** Headlines:

- **s021** (100 seeds × 1000 random `(q0, ω)` candidates, 22 min Pool(8)). Truth scores 1.0 on alignment for 80/100 seeds, 1.0 on geo for 73/76 defined seeds. Body-twin matches truth (corrected convention: q_180x · q0 + R_180x · ω; the old concept page Y-axis claim was wrong, fixed). Truth percentile rank in random distribution: median 0.001 (top 0.1%); 73/100 in top 1% on alignment, 71/100 on geo.
- **s022** (1.1s): 15/15 known multi-solution candidates (s014 band-A∪B, q0_err > 10°) score alignment 1.0; 1/1 in-basin (seed 28, ρ=1.58) scores 1.0/1.0. **No false negatives against any known-good candidate.**
- **s023** (post-process): per-seed **median rejection at truth-100%-retention threshold = 1.000 on alignment, geo, AND intersection.** Cohort mean: 0.989 / 0.759 / 0.991. Filter orthogonality Pearson 0.167 / Spearman 0.189 — different physics. Stratification clean across tier-coverage classes (T1-rich/multi-tier/sub3-peak/zero-classifiable) and n_rotations classes; even zero-classifiable cohort-tail seeds get align rejection median 1.000.
- **s027** (post-process): **88/100 seeds have ZERO random survivors at calibrated threshold.** Filter intersection annihilates the random panel on most seeds. The 12 seeds with survivors classify their top cluster as "other" — surfacing genuine multi-solution structure for free.
- **s024** (3-seed pilot): tested alignment cost as ω-LOCALIZER (max over Sobol q0 per ω-cell). 1/3 seeds localizes truth-ω; 2/3 fail at 2× truth-ω-mag (peak-density harmonic artifact). **Verdict: alignment cost is a FILTER, not a localizer.** ω-localization stays with the LS-bracket (s019).
- **s025** (5-seed tube-shape, 10s): per-axis filter roll-off. Geo cost is sharper (ω-dir basin ~1°, q0 basin ~5°). Alignment cost is wider on q0/ω-dir but extremely tight on ω-mag (drops to 0.0-0.5 at any non-zero perturbation). Filter tube anisotropic: q0 wide / ω-dir narrow / ω-mag narrowest — matches LS-bracket's 5% accuracy.

**Strategic implication for s020:** insert a filter-rejection stage between IC generation and LM polish:

| stage | purpose | per-candidate cost |
|---|---|---|
| IC generator | bracket × phi-sweep × Sobol | — |
| **Filter (alignment + geo)** | reject ≥99% of random at truth threshold | sub-second |
| Surrogate-MSE | rank survivors | seconds (LM) |
| Hi-fi ρ-band | top-K validation | minutes |

Implementation: 10-line addition between the s020 IC pool and the LM polish. Filters compose well (orthogonal physics) and preserve all known multi-solution candidates. Expected speedup on the s020 LM budget: 10-100×.

**Pre-registered s020 question (revised):** does bracket-augmented S016-A + filter-rejection + LM polish produce ≥4/5 Band A∪B candidates per pilot seed? Now with the filter step the wall budget drops dramatically — 5-seed pilot might fit in ~30 min instead of ~2 hr.

### s018c ω-grab decomposition (2026-05-03 follow-up)

(Architectural decision retained for context.) The s018c phi-sweep IC primitive is sound at truth-ω (seed 6 → q0_err = 0.287°, surr_MSE = 2.79e-3 ≈ s001 truth_mse_ref) but does not on its own bridge the ω-fragility tube. Diagnostic (`scratch/s018c_omega_grab.py`, 15 cells × 32 LMs each on seed 6, 36 min wall) measured the JOINT tube as **|Δω-dir| ≤ 1° AND Δω-mag ∈ [-10%, +5%]** simultaneously. Outside this tube the LM-best q0 lands at 100°-180° from truth (Band D). Naive joint coverage would need ~180 000 cells per seed — infeasible.

**s019/s019b decomposed this**: with ω-mag pinned via bracket, ω-dir basin is 3-5° (s019b). With ω-dir pinned at truth, ω-mag tolerance was -10% / +5% (s018c). The bottleneck was the joint requirement; treating the axes separately makes the architecture feasible.

**Pilot CANCELLED at the design gate.** Per the cost-benefit rule: running the proposed 5-seed phi-sweep × coarse-ω pilot would just re-confirm the diagnostic (predicted 0/5 Band A∪B at any feasible ω-grid). 36-min diagnostic replaced 3-8 hr pilot.

s018c remains valuable as a **q0-IC sub-component** inside S016-A: any S016-A grid cell that lands inside the tube (|Δdir| ≤ 1°, Δmag in [-10%, +5%]) can use phi-sweep q0 ICs in place of Sobol-Shoemake N=64. This is the only known IC source that places candidates inside the s006 ~2° basin without needing q0-Sobol density.

  basin-recovery proxy is "final surrogate-MSE matches s001 truth-MSE
  within 9%" — strong but not ρ-band-classifiable.
- **Cohort-scale basin-radius probe.** s005 only measured 5 seeds. If
  worst-case basins are tighter than seed 28's 2° on a non-trivial
  cohort fraction, Q4c calibration needs revision.

## Last measured

**s032 + s033 + s034 — cohort fast-path + density sensitivity + LM polish basin recovery on seed 89 (2026-05-05).**

**s032 — full 100-seed cohort run, 266 min wall.** Added `MEASURE_GEO_FAIL_ALIGN = False` gate (default OFF) → **49× speedup** on seed 6 (75s vs 3,684s baseline; better than the 6.7× the s020 writeup predicted because gating skips the surrogate forward pass too, not just align cost). Also fixed pre-existing `twin_q0` no-survivors crash. **Outcome: 78 OK + 1 CACHED + 21 FAIL** — 19 zero-classifiable matching s018b's prediction EXACTLY (4, 9, 10, 30, 32, 33, 41, 48, 51, 52, 54, 66, 70, 71, 81, 82, 86, 91, 99) + 2 fixable bugs (0, 3). **Cohort wall: median 35s, p90 13.4 min, max 49.9 min (seed 84).** Survivor distribution: median 0, p75=398, p90=2153, max=19,847 (seed 57); 47/79 zero-survivor at strict 1.0/1.0 thresholds, 27/79 with ≥100 survivors. **Headline: bracket subsampling cohort coverage is dramatically worse than s019 claimed — 4/79 within 5% (vs s019's 98/100), median 32%, p90 71%.** s020 takes top-N LS peaks (capped at peak count) rather than densely subsampling the full geometric grid; this collapses s019's full-grid coverage to a fraction. **Seed 6's 4.6% — s031's reference — is in the BEST decile.** s031's "framework structurally constrained" extrapolation was measuring this subsampling artefact, NOT a fundamental limit.

**s033 — density sensitivity on seed 89 (5 progressive runs, ~30 min total).** Discovered + fixed bracket-subsampling cap (s020 was capping at LS-peak count → seed 89's nominal N_mag=20 silently became N_mag=7). Patched `run_bracket()` to pad with cells from `bracket_full_grid` when N_mag exceeds peak count, filtering grid cells already within 5% of LS peaks. **Sub-linear wall scaling observed: factor ~0.9 per cell-count multiplier.** **q0-best closes hierarchically with each density axis:** 50.4° baseline → 15.2° at N_mag=20 (cap-bound) → 15.2° at N_mag=50 with bracket inside s003 tube (1.91% from truth) → **8.59°** at N_dir=300→2000 → **7.86°** at N_phi=12→60 (only 9% closer — **off-circle floor identified**: truth-q0 doesn't lie on any spec-anchored phi-circle). Per-seed wall: baseline 14.5s → N_dir=2000+N_mag=20 = 5.7m → +N_phi=60 = 25.7m. Cohort projection at N_dir=2000+N_mag=20: ~4.2 days for the 78 OK seeds. Disk: 388 MB/seed at N_dir=2000+N_mag=20 (cohort×100 = ~30 GB).

**s034 — LM polish on top-50 surrogate-MSE survivors of s033_n2000_m20 → DECISIVE POSITIVE, basin hit.** Joint (q0, ω) Levenberg-Marquardt via `scipy.optimize.least_squares(method='lm')`, surrogate-MSE objective against truth LC, 6-parameter rotvec-pert + omega-delta, x0=zeros. **24/50 polished into surrogate Band A; best predicted ρ=0.37 (Band A), q0→truth=0.86°, ω-dir=0.11°, ω-mag=-0.02°.** Convergence basins: ranks 2/4 land truth basin; ranks 0/3/10/20 land class_3 near-180° twin (q0~174°); rank 40 lands a mid-q0 multi-solution (q0=60°). Total wall **5.4 min single-thread**. LM iterations median 27, p90 76. **Critical convention pitfall:** initial s034 run had a transpose bug — wrongly flipped `Rotation.from_quat().as_matrix()` based on a stale assumption; the s020 helper correctly does NOT transpose under the post-fix quaternion convention. Buggy run produced LM divergence (every polish made ρ WORSE); fix produced basin recovery. Lesson: forward-function smoke-test against cached `k1_body`/`k2_body` is mandatory before trusting any new inversion experiment. **Combined density+polish wall on seed 89: ~10 min end-to-end.** Cohort extrapolation if seed-89-typical ~14 hr; with realistic 5× outlier slowdown ~3-4 days.

**Two outstanding caveats before declaring framework end-to-end validated:**
1. **Hi-fi confirmation needed.** Per s017, surrogate is over-pessimistic at truth by ~20×; predicted ρ=0.37 likely maps to hi-fi ρ ≈ 1-2 (still A∪B but unconfirmed). Hi-fi rerank of the 24 surrogate-Band-A polished candidates: ~1 min Pool(8).
2. **Single-seed result on a favorable seed.** Seed 89 is fast, mid-density, classifiable, with baseline signal. Generalisation to zero-classifiable / very-slow / outside-bracket seeds untested.

Artefacts: `experiments/s020_seed_pipeline.py` (geo-fail gate + bracket padding + n-phi flag + twin_q0 fix), `experiments/s032_cohort_fast.{sh,md}`, `experiments/s033_density_sensitivity.md`, `experiments/s034_lm_polish_seed89.{py,md}`, `results/s032_cohort_fast/`, `results/s033_n{mag20,mag50,2000_m20,2000_m20_phi60}_smoke/seed089/`, `results/s034_lm_polish_seed089/polish_summary.json`.

### Older "last measured" (s021..s027 filter framework), retained for context

**s021 / s022 / s023 / s024 / s025 / s027 — necessary-condition filter discovery suite (2026-05-04).**

User insight (morning 2026-05-04): alignment cost & geo cost were used as ranking metrics (which fails — they're not unique to truth) but should have been used as one-sided rejection filters (necessary-condition direction: truth → high score → retain; low score → reject). Six experiments validated this on the cohort:

- **s021** (Pool(8), 22 min wall): 100 seeds × 1000 random + truth + body-twin scoring. Truth scores 1.0 on alignment for 80/100, on geo for 73/76 defined. Body-twin matches truth on every recoverable seed — **corrected twin convention** (X-axis with ω-transform, not the old Y-axis-with-same-ω claim; concept page updated). Truth percentile rank in random distribution: median 0.001 (top 0.1%).
- **s022** (1.1 s): all 15 known multi-solution candidates from s014 score alignment 1.0; in-basin candidate scores 1.0/1.0. **No false negatives.**
- **s023** (post-process): median 100% / 100% / 100% rejection at truth-retention threshold across alignment / geo / intersection. Cohort mean 0.989 / 0.759 / 0.991. Filter orthogonality Pearson 0.167 → composes well.
- **s027** (post-process): **88/100 seeds have ZERO random survivors at threshold** — filter annihilates random panel.
- **s024** (3-seed pilot, 4 min): alignment cost tested as ω-LOCALIZER. 1/3 wins truth; 2/3 fail at 2× truth-ω-mag (peak-density harmonic artifact). Stays as filter, not localizer; bracket (s019) keeps the ω-prior role.
- **s025** (5-seed tube-shape, 10 s): per-axis roll-off. Geo basin ~1° ω-dir / ~5° q0; alignment basin ~5-15° q0 / ~5° ω-dir but 0-0.5 on any non-zero ω-mag perturbation. Filter tube is anisotropic; LS-bracket's 5% ω-mag accuracy matches the alignment-cost ω-mag sensitivity scale.

**Decisive finding:** the buggy-era / s004 "alignment cost is anti-truth" verdict was a category error. The metric was being used as an optimisation target (sufficient-condition predictor), where it rightly fails because some bad trajectories also score low. As a necessary-condition rejection filter (truth → high score), the metric is universal: median 100% rejection of random at truth-100%-retention threshold across the cohort. Geo cost extends this with face-PAB constraints from s018b's tier classifier; the two filters are weakly correlated (Pearson 0.167) and compose multiplicatively.

**Strategic implication:** s020 architecture revised. Insert filter-rejection between IC generation and LM polish. Expected speedup on cohort-scale wall budget: 10-100×, depending on per-seed filter strength.

Artefacts: `lib/filter_costs.py`, `experiments/s021_truth_vs_random.{py,md}`, `s022_known_good.{py,md}`, `s023_filter_composition.{py,md}`, `s024_omega_prior_pilot.{py,md}`, `s025_tube_shape.{py,md}`, `s027_cluster_topology.{py,md}`, `concepts/twin_degeneracy.md` (CORRECTED), `results/s021..s027/`, `scratch/s021_smoke.py`, `scratch/s021_tune_alignment.py`.

### Older "last measured" (s018c), retained for context

**s018c — phi-sweep IC generator + ω-grab diagnostic (2026-05-02; pilot CANCELLED at the gate).** Three diagnostics on seed 6, total compute ~50 min:

1. **Smoke (math validation, `scratch/s018c_smoke.py`).** Geometric story PASS at machine precision (PAB-alignment angle matches cached `min_ang_dist` to <1e-6 deg); back-prop convention determined to be **LEFT** (`q0 = Φ⁻¹ ⊗ q_target`); phi-sweep round-trip recovers truth-q0 to ~1e-6 deg in the ideal case; closest IC at 1° phi-step matches `min_ang_dist` (3.15° vs 3.12° on the seed-6 +Y-face spec5 peak).
2. **Truth-ω diagnostic (`scratch/s018c_smoke_truth_omega.py`).** Single-cell ω-grid at truth-ω: best q0_err = 0.287°, ω_dir_err = 0.014°, ω_mag_err = -0.002%, final_surr_MSE = 2.79e-3 mag² (matches s001 cached truth_mse_ref 2.92e-3 to 4.5%; ρ ≈ 1.05 → Band A). 288 ICs from 4 bright peaks (2 T2 × 4 faces + 2 T3 × 8 faces) × 12 phi; top-64 LM polished. **Phi-sweep IC + LM machinery is sound when ω is at truth.**
3. **ω-grab perturbation sweep (`scratch/s018c_omega_grab.py`).** 15 ω cells × 32 LM-polished ICs each on seed 6, 36 min wall on Pool(8). Sweeps ω-dir at {0,1,5,10,20,30,60}° and ω-mag at {-50,-20,-10,-5,+5,+10,+20,+50}% from truth. **Decisive negative on the joint-search ω-grid architecture:** only |Δdir| ≤ 1° AND Δmag ∈ [-10%, +5%] keep LM-best in basin. 5° dir already collapses to q0_err = 161° (best) / 12.6° (closest of 32). +10% mag collapses to 179° / 37°. ω-mag perturbation is asymmetric — negative side ≥10% in basin, positive side <10%.

**Cost-benefit gate:** the planned 5-seed × 3-8 hr pilot at any feasible ω-grid (12-48 dir × 3-6 mag) was now known to predict 0/5 Band A∪B by architecture; running it would re-confirm the diagnostic. **PILOT CANCELLED.**

**Decisive findings:**
- Phi-sweep q0-IC primitive is geometrically sound and inherits the s003 ω-fragility tube (~1° dir, asymmetric mag) — bottleneck shifted, not eliminated.
- Phi-sweep is **valuable as a sub-component inside S016-A**: any S016-A cell within 1°/[-10%,+5%] of truth-ω can be seeded with phi-sweep ICs, putting candidates inside even the s006 ~2° basin.
- Naive coverage of the cohort ω-mag range [0.106, 1.476] dps × ω-dir uniform on S² to 1° dir / 5% mag spacing requires ~180k cells/seed — infeasible without an ω-prior.

**Trajectory-class architecture switching reaffirmed:** zero-classifiable seeds (19/100, including the originally-planned-pilot 41 and 91) need a different IC primitive — phi-sweep cannot help them at all. Sobol fallback or LC-dim-envelope structuring is a separate question.

Artefacts: `experiments/s018c_phi_sweep_pilot.{py,md}`, `experiments/s018c_hifi_rerank.py` (kept for future S016-A integration), `scratch/s018c_*.py`, `results/s018c_truth_omega_diag/`, `results/s018c_omega_grab_diag/{summary.json, lm_grab_in_omega.png}`.

| 84   | 5.07  | 38.6°   | 3          | class_3 (2.49), class_3 (2.86), class_3 (3.88) |

Class_2 (q0 ∈ [30°, 150°] + near-truth ω) seeds — 10, 41, 48 — span
n_rot {1.06, 5.65, 2.57}, median 2.57. **Class_3 (q0 ≥ 170° near-180°
flip + near-truth ω) is the surprising structural finding:** 5 distinct
near-180° attractors at q0_err 171°-179.6° (NOT exactly 180°, NOT pure
body-twins — twin recoveries 0/640 in s011, 0/50 in s005, 0/256 in
s013, all at strict body-X 180° pole). m048 geometry has approximate
near-flip symmetries detectable when LC information content is moderate
(seeds 48 low-rot, 84 mid-rot hit them; high-rot seeds do not).

Class_1 (seed 28 q0=2.1°/ω_dir=2.0°/|ω_mag|=0%, ρ=1.58 Band A) is a
basin-definition artefact — at truth-q0 with ω just outside strict
basin (ω_dir 2° vs strict 1°). Adopting loose basin (ω_dir<2°) or
hi-fi-ρ<2 directly reclassifies it as in-basin.

**Mechanism story coherent across 5 measurements** (s007 / s008 / s012a
/ s013 / s014b): low-rotation multi-periodic LCs jointly under-determine
(q0, ω). Mechanism not directly verified (would require constructing two
specific (q0, ω) tuples producing identical LC at low rotation count).

**Implications for s015:**
- Include 2-3 of the n_rot<2 cohort tail (e.g., seeds 13 / 42 / 79) as
  calibration targets. Predicted ~10/100 cohort failure rate at fixed
  truth-ω matches s011 pilot 1/10 = 10%, independently corroborating
  pilot representativeness.
- Survey acceptance bar (ρ<4) admits all class_2/class_3 multi-solution
  candidates. **Tightening to ρ<3.5 would flip seed 10 (3.90) and seed
  84's q0=179.6° cluster (3.88) to FAILURE** — decision must precede
  s015 if bar is being tightened.
- PA stratification is secondary; **n_rot is the dominant predictor**.
  For s015 IC selection, prioritise n_rot bands (low/mid/high), then
  PA spread within each band.

Artefacts: `experiments/s014b_n_rotations_analysis.{py,md}`,
`results/s014b/{seed_metadata.npz, clusters.json, summary.json,
n_rotations_vs_rho.png, pa_vs_rho.png, multi_solution_breakdown.png}`,
`results/s014b_run.log` (gitignored).

What s014b does NOT decide:
- Direct LC-degeneracy mechanism verification (would require constructing
  matched LCs from distinct (q0, ω)).
- Cohort-scale extension of the n_rot↔ρ-min correlation. Pilot is
  10 seeds; s012 needs to extend to 100.
- Class_3 mechanism — m048 geometry near-symmetry vs surrogate-LM
  artefact vs LC coincidence.

**s014 — cohort-scale hi-fi ρ-band of s011 non-basin + s005 (2026-05-01).**
590 hi-fi renders (540 s011 non-basin non-seed-10 + 50 s005 all),
Pool(8) with `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1` + `torch.set_num_threads(1)`, wall
**5626 s = 93.8 min** (76.3 s per render per worker — matches s013).
Combined with s013 cohort A's 36 in-basin landings, n=576 total covers
the full 64 ICs per seed × 9 recoverable s011 seeds.

**Decisive positive: cohort architecture trust confirmed.**
- **Cohort-wide Spearman(surrogate_MSE, ρ) on n=576: 0.9952.**
- Per-seed Spearman: 7/9 ≥ 0.95 raw; **9/9 ≥ 0.995 finite-only.**
  Seeds 28 and 60 have 7+4 hi-fi-`inf` candidates at extreme q0
  attitudes (zero-flux LCs). Properly classified as Band D; only
  effect is mild Spearman penalty when ranks pair surrogate-mid-MSE
  against hi-fi-inf.
- **Surrogate-best ρ == hi-fi-best ρ on 9/9 seeds** (the 4/9 row-
  identity match is misleading — in-basin landings cluster to
  numerically-equivalent ρ; "best by row ID" picks an arbitrary tie
  but ρ values agree).
- Cohort A band counts (n=540 non-basin only): A=7, B=9, C=23, D=501.

**Multi-solution at cohort scale, NOT seed-10-specific.** 4/9 seeds
(28, 41, 48, 84) carry Band A∪B candidates outside in-basin — 16 in
cohort A + 1 in cohort B = 17 total. Three structural classes:
| class                                    | example seeds | n  |
|-----------------------------------------|---------------|----|
| near-truth-q0 + off-truth-ω             | 28 (q0=2.1°, ω_dir=2.0°) | 1 |
| q0=30°-150° + near-truth ω              | 41 (q0=143°), 48 (q0=44°) [+ s013 seed 10 (q0=32°)] | 3 |
| near-180° flip + near-truth ω           | 48 (q0=177-179°), 84 (q0=171-179°) | 13 |

**Cross-cohort confirmation:** seed 41's q0=143°/ω_dir=2°/|ω_mag|=2.8%
landing appears in BOTH s011 cohort A AND s005 cohort B (s011_row 257
and s005 seed-41 T4) — same physical attractor reached from different
ICs.

**All 17 multi-solution candidates are SECOND-best in surrogate MSE.**
The in-basin truth landing remains the surrogate-argmin per seed.
Cohort architecture's selector returns truth-basin Band A; multi-
solution candidates are visible as additional Band A∪B landings in
the per-seed top-K but not selected.

**Hi-fi / surrogate MSE ratio is regime-dependent.**
- **Non-basin (n=540):** median 1.000, p10-p90 [0.998, 1.006] —
  surrogate ≈ hi-fi to <1% deviation. Surrogate MSE can be used as
  direct hi-fi proxy for any non-basin candidate.
- **In-basin (n=36):** median 0.048, p10-p90 [0.012, 0.061] —
  surrogate is ~20× pessimistic at truth because its intrinsic noise
  floor (~3e-3 mag² typical) does not vanish at truth, while hi-fi
  MSE drops to ≪ 1e-4. Both rank truth correctly; the absolute
  ratio just isn't meaningful sub-noise-floor.
- **s005 all (n=50):** median 0.178, p10 0.020, p90 1.001 — bimodal
  reflecting the 30:20 in-basin / non-basin split.

**Strict basin definition is conservative.** Seed 28 has a near-miss
landing at q0_err=2.1°, ω_dir=2.0°, |ω_mag|=0.0% (s011 ic_idx 33,
s011_row 207). Fails strict ω_dir<1° → tagged not-in-basin. Renders
ρ=1.58 (Band A). Hi-fi-ρ < 2 is wider than the strict (q0<5° / ω_dir<1°
/ |ω_mag|<5%) rule. Future basin-definition work should adopt either
loose-strict (q0<10° / ω_dir<2° / |ω_mag|<10%) or hi-fi-ρ < 2 directly.

**Edge case: 11 hi-fi-`inf` candidates** (seeds 28: 7, seed 60: 4).
At q0_err 70°-170°, certain attitudes produce LCs where every facet
is fully self-shadowed at every observation epoch → zero flux →
+inf mag. The surrogate (smooth interpolant) predicts non-zero
magnitude here; hi-fi correctly returns inf. Worth flagging as a
forward-model edge case but not load-bearing — these candidates
have surrogate MSE 3-10 mag² (well above in-basin truth 6e-4) and
would never be selected by cohort architecture.

Artefacts: `experiments/s014_cohort_rho_band.{py,md}`,
`experiments/s014_post_analysis.py`,
`results/s014/{rho_s011_nb.npz, rho_s005.npz, summary.json,
analysis_summary.json, surrogate_vs_hifi_scatter.png, rho_per_seed.png,
ratio_distribution.png}`, `results/s014_run.log` (gitignored).

What s014 does NOT decide:
- The 100-seed cohort fail-rate distribution (s012, pending). Whether
  the 9-seed pilot is representative of the cohort-tail behaviour.
- Whether basin-hopping recovers truth on seed 10 (still low priority
  given multi-solution acceptance).
- Mechanism for the seed 28/60 hi-fi-inf edge case.
- N_rotations vs ρ-min cross-cohort correlation (the "low-rotation
  tumblers under-determine (q0, ω)" hypothesis — now feasible to
  measure cohort-wide with s014 data).

**s013 — hi-fi ρ-band validation of s011 / s012a candidates (2026-05-01).**
Built `lib/hifi_render.py` (copy-adapted from
`notebooks/inversion/lib/lc_compare.py:generate_hifi_lc` per workspace
contract; smoke test round-trips `mag_hifi` to bit-identical on seeds
6/10/91). 292 hi-fi renders × Pool(8), wall 2680 s (44.7 min;
per-worker render wall ~73 s — slower than expected, likely shadow-engine
/ trimesh internal threading not capped by `OMP_NUM_THREADS`). Two cohorts:

(A) **s011 in-basin landings — 36/36 Band A.** ρ ∈ [0.040, 0.230],
median 0.078. All 9 recoverable seeds' LM-converged in-basin states
render solidly within the noise floor in hi-fi terms — sanity check
passed. The s005/s009/s011 strict basin definition (q0<5° / ω_dir<1° /
|ω_mag|<5%) maps cleanly to hi-fi ρ ≪ 1.

(B) **Seed-10 N=256 final states (cohort B).** ρ ∈ [3.90, 33.05],
median 7.82. Bands A=0, **B=2**, C=132, D=122. Greedy 5° geodesic
clustering on q0_final yields 158 distinct basins (1 B + 75 C + 82 D).
**DECISION: MULTI_SOLUTION at the boundary** — 2/256 candidates
(0.78%) achieve Band B; both ICs (#6 and #86) converge to a single
basin (geodesic 0.013° between them) at ρ=3.90 with q0_err=31.82°,
ω_dir_err=2.70°, |ω_mag_err|=+2.24%. Hi-fi MSE = 0.0381 mag²,
surrogate MSE = 0.0346 mag² (ratio 1.10).

**Strong corollary: Spearman correlation surrogate ↔ hi-fi MSE on seed
10 = 0.999.** Surrogate-best landing = hi-fi-best landing (same IC #6).
Hi-fi MSE / surrogate MSE median = 1.003 (p10=0.987, p90=1.041) —
surrogate is bias-free against hi-fi on seed 10. **A "find lowest
surrogate-MSE candidate per seed" cohort architecture would have output
the Band B candidate without needing a separate hi-fi rerank step.**

**Boundary fragility.** ρ-min on seed 10 is 3.90, only 0.10 below the
survey's ρ < 4 acceptance bar. The next-best basin (cluster 65, IC#195,
q0=178.9°/ω_dir=2.2°) sits at ρ=4.16 — Band C. Tightening the
acceptance bar to ρ < 3.5 would flip seed 10 from MULTI_SOLUTION to
GENUINE_FAILURE. **Seed-10-class is at the LC information-content
boundary, not comfortably inside a multi-solution regime.**

The Band B candidate's geometry tells the story: ω matches truth
tightly (dir 2.7°, mag 2.2%), but q0 is 31.8° off. The surrogate has
found a different attitude with similar dynamics whose LC matches
truth's at the multi-solution boundary. Mechanism (consistent with
s007/s008/s012a, not directly verified): seed 10 has only 1.06
rotations sampled; multi-periodic LCs from low-rotation tumblers
under-determine (q0, ω) jointly.

Implications:
- **Cohort architecture confirmed.** "Uniform Sobol(q0) on SO(3) at
  N=64 + LM polish at truth-ω + select lowest-surrogate-MSE per seed"
  produces a ρ < 4 (Band A∪B) candidate on at least 9/10 of the
  s011 pilot. The surrogate's local-minimum structure is faithful to
  hi-fi.
- **Seed-10-class is "solved" at boundary acceptance.** Multi-solution
  candidates exist but with narrow margin. Future work that tightens
  the acceptance bar must re-classify these.
- **Hi-fi rerank is unnecessary on seed 10.** Whether this generalises
  to the cohort needs measurement — extend s013 to the 540 not-in-basin
  not-seed-10 s011 candidates (~6 min Pool(8)) is the cheap follow-up.

Artefacts: `experiments/s013_rho_band_validation.{py,md}`,
`lib/hifi_render.py` (new), `results/s013/{rho_in_basin.npz,
rho_seed10.npz, summary.json, clusters.json, rho_distribution.png}`,
`results/s013_run.log` (gitignored).

What s013 does NOT decide:
- Whether the surrogate ↔ hi-fi rank correlation (0.999 on seed 10)
  holds across the cohort (cheap follow-up: cohort-scale ρ-band).
- The cohort-scale fail-rate distribution under the multi-solution
  framing — pending s012 cohort scan (full 100 seeds × N=64).
- Whether basin-hopping could find the truth basin on seed 10
  (now lower priority given multi-solution acceptance).
- Whether N=512+ Sobol density on seed 10 ever recovers truth basin
  (still cheap insurance, but now low-priority — multi-solution accepted).
- Mechanism verification for low-rotation tumblers (the "1.06 rotations
  → multi-solution" claim is consistent across s007/s008/s012a/s013
  but not directly tested).

**s012a — seed-10 single-seed N=256 probe (Q4c-ii diagnostic)
(2026-05-01).** Single seed (10), 192 new ICs at Sobol indices 64..255
(extending s011's first 64 with `qmc.Sobol.fast_forward(64) + .random(192)`,
SOBOL_SEED=42). Pre-run consistency check confirmed first-64 Sobol points
match s011's stored q0_seed_wxyz to machine precision. Pool(8), BLAS=1,
torch threads=1, max_nfev=60. Wall 588 s on the new 192 (mean 24.5 s/run).

**Decisive H2 confirmed: 0/64 → 0/128 → 0/256 in-basin (strict).** Twin
recoveries 0/256.

| N    | in-basin | unique | competing | min q0 | min q0<30° | min mse | min mse<30° |
|------|----------|--------|-----------|--------|------------|---------|-------------|
| 64   | 0        | 0      | 49        | 28.25° | 28.25°     | 0.0346  | 0.142       |
| 128  | 0        | 0      | 76        | 28.25° | 28.25°     | 0.0346  | 0.142       |
| 256  | 0        | 0      | 123       | 12.95° | 12.95°     | 0.0346  | 0.0989      |

Findings:
- **N=128 added zero new information vs N=64** (same closest landing,
  same min mse). The 64 new ICs all landed in already-discovered
  competing basins. N=256 added 1 closer-to-truth Sobol point (initial
  46.72°) which LM partially funnelled to 12.95° but ω drifted off
  (ω_dir_err=19.65°, ω_mag_err=+4.78%) — not in basin.
- **Best LM-discovered surrogate-MSE minimum (0.0346 mag², 9.6× truth)
  is invariant in N.** Found at N=64 and unchanged at N=128/256. Same
  competing basin = global LM attractor across the IC space.
- **Sobol coverage of truth neighbourhood is sparse:** at N=256 only
  1/256 ICs lies within 30° of truth-q0; 0/256 within 20°. Expected
  closest-Sobol-to-truth at N=256 is ~14° on SO(3); we observed 29°
  (within Sobol-noise but conservatively poor).
- **Competing-basin growth is sub-linear** (49→76→123 over 4× density):
  large but finite fragmented landscape, not pure noise.
- **Multiple ICs converge on a strong competing attractor at
  (q0_err≈46°, ω_dir_err≈19°, |ω_mag|<1%, mse≈0.11):** ICs 77 / 231 /
  149 / 220 / 44 (5 of the 12 closest initials). Other neighbouring
  ICs scatter to far attractors (124-145°). LM's basin-of-attraction
  map is fragmented, not smooth.

Mechanism (consistent across s007 / s008 / s012a, not yet directly
verified): seed 10 has only 1.055 rotations sampled in its 1-hour
window — slowest in s011's pilot at 6.33 deg/min. The LC under-
determines (q0, ω) with so few rotations; s007 + s008 had established
this for ω-magnitude (cheap and model-aware priors fail). s012a
extends the pattern: q0 is also multi-modal in surrogate-MSE space
when rotations are scarce.

Strategic implications:
- **Pure SO(3) Sobol + LM polish at fixed truth-ω fails on seed-10-
  class for any feasible density.** 4× (N=64→256) gives no recovery;
  N=512/1024 would push closest-Sobol from 13° toward 6-8° but the LM
  grab radius for seed 10 appears to be < 13°, so further N likely
  doesn't help.
- **Hi-fi ρ-band classification (s013) of the 123 competing basins is
  the gating measurement.** If the best-mse competing basins (e.g.
  the strong attractor at q0≈46°/mse≈0.11 or the global-best at
  mse=0.0346) are ρ < 4 (Band A∪B), seed 10 IS a multi-solution
  case (per `concepts/observational_indistinguishability.md`) and
  the survey's success bar is already met. If they are ρ ≥ 4
  (Band C∪D), seed 10 is a genuine inversion failure needing
  basin-hopping or partial-cohort acceptance.
- **For the s012 cohort scan (still-pending Q4c-ii at full 100 seeds)**:
  expect 5-15% of cohort to be seed-10-class and density-irrecoverable;
  s012 should record competing-basin counts and best-mse to allow
  per-seed ρ-band classification post-hoc.

Artefacts: `experiments/s012a_seed10_density_probe.{py,md}`,
`results/s012a/{runs.npz, runs_combined.npz, summary.json,
yield_curve.png, q0_err_distribution.png}`,
`results/s012a_run.log` (gitignored).

What s012a does NOT decide:
- Whether N=512/1024 recovers seed 10 (likely no, but unmeasured).
- Whether seed-10-class is multi-solution or genuine failure
  (s013 hi-fi ρ-band is the next decisive measurement).
- Whether basin-hopping recovers seed 10 (untested).
- Whether seed 10 needs an ω-grid (truth-ω was the IC here; the
  competing basins discovered at near-truth ω suggest ω-grid won't
  help unless the truth basin is structurally isolated from generic
  ICs at ALL ω, which would be even worse news).
- The cohort fail-rate distribution (still pending in s012).

**s011 — Q4c-ii cohort pilot: multi-axis Sobol(q0) on SO(3) + LM polish
at truth-ω (2026-05-01).** 10 PA-stratified seeds (8 s002 anchors +
2 cohort-tail seeds 28 / 44) × 64 Sobol-Shoemake quaternions × LM
polish per IC = 640 LM runs. Pool(8), BLAS=1, max_nfev=60. Wall
2361 s = 39.4 min after fixing critical torch-threading bug (see below).

**Decisive positive: cohort yield 9/10 at N=64 (90.0%).** DECISION:
Sobol-q0 cheap; Q4c works at low density.

Per-seed in-basin counts (out of 64):

| seed | in-basin / 64 | min q0_err | min final_mse | competing basins |
|------|---------------|------------|---------------|------------------|
| 6    | 8 (12.5%)    | 0.29°      | 2.79e-3       | 5  |
| 10   | **0** (FAIL) | 28.25°     | 3.46e-2       | **49** |
| 21   | 3 (4.7%)     | 0.02°      | 5.72e-4       | 1  |
| 28   | 7 (10.9%)    | 0.03°      | 5.78e-4       | 1  |
| 41   | 2 (3.1%)     | 1.05°      | 1.21e-4       | 2  |
| 44   | 5 (7.8%)     | 0.03°      | 3.21e-4       | 4  |
| 48   | 1 (1.6%)     | 0.19°      | 2.81e-4       | 13 |
| 60   | 4 (6.3%)     | 0.06°      | 1.54e-3       | 3  |
| 84   | 3 (4.7%)     | 0.18°      | 2.45e-4       | 5  |
| 91   | 3 (4.7%)     | 0.07°      | 2.01e-4       | 3  |

Twin recoveries: 0/640 (consistent with s005, s009, s010).
All in-basin landings are single-cluster (n_unique=1) — single truth
basin everywhere.

**Major finding (changes the strategic picture):** LM has a basin-grab
radius FAR larger than the basin itself.

- s006 measured seed-28 truth basin invisible at Sobol-2046 (closest
  10°); s005 said basin radius ~2°. Yet at N=64 (cell radius ~28°),
  seed 28 gets **7/64 in-basin landings**.
- s010 measured seed-44 competing basin sub-Sobol-narrow; s011 gets
  **5/64 in-basin landings on seed 44** at N=64.
- Mechanism: LM finite-difference-Jacobian Levenberg-Marquardt funnels
  into truth from up to ~75-100° away in q0_geodesic when ω is at
  truth (smoke test: 75° init q0 → basin in 11 nfev).
- **This invalidates the s006-driven worry** that sub-Sobol-narrow
  basins force high Sobol density. Sobol density just needs to seed
  inside the LM grab radius (~50-100°), much larger than the basin.

**New finding: seed 10 is a multi-axis tight-tail seed.** s009 said
seed 10 passed body-X-axis T1 strict; s011 gets **0/64 in-basin** at
multi-axis Sobol. All 64 ICs land at q0_err 28°-180° (median 137°);
55/64 final_mse < 0.5 mag²; 5/64 mse < 0.05 same order as truth_mse_ref
(3.59e-3). 49 distinct competing-basin clusters detected. The body-X-
axis IC for seed 10 happens to LM-polish into truth; generic SO(3)
ICs do not. **The multi-axis cohort tail is broader than s009's
body-X estimate (3/100 → likely 5-10/100).**

**Competing basins are widespread on most seeds.** 5/10 seeds have
≥3 LM-discovered competing basins at low MSE far from truth; seed 10
(49 clusters) and seed 48 (13 clusters) have particularly dense
multi-attractor landscapes. s002's "argmin=truth at fixed truth-ω" is
preserved (truth is the global argmin per s002/s006/s010), but local-
minimum structure is dense — LM polish discovers them, bare Sobol
doesn't.

**Critical methodology learned:** torch ignores `OMP_NUM_THREADS` env
var and defaults to `cpu_count // 2` (16 threads here). Pool(N)
workers each spinning 16 threads → massive oversubscription → ~8×
slowdown. Fix: `torch.set_num_threads(1)` + `torch.set_num_interop_
threads(1)` inside `init_worker` BEFORE any tensor op. Without it, an
identical Pool(8) batch produces NO results in 3 minutes despite all
workers at 99% CPU. Updated `memory/feedback_blas_threads_for_pool.md`
with the torch addendum.

Implications for Q4c at full cohort:
- **100-seed cohort wall at N=64 (single machine):** ~640 × 26 s ×
  10 = ~6.5 hours / 8 workers. Single-shot cohort scan is feasible.
- **Full s012 ω-grid extension (5×5 = 25 cells):** ~6.5 hours × 25
  = ~160 hours. Needs cluster, multi-machine, or budget pruning of
  ω-grid.
- **Seed-10-class failure rate at cohort:** unknown. The s011 pilot
  (1/10 fail) suggests 5-10% cohort fail rate at N=64 truth-ω. Likely
  N=256 or basin-hopping recovers some. The 100-seed cohort run is
  needed to convert this estimate to a measurement.

Artefacts: `experiments/s011_q4cii_sobol_so3_polish_pilot.{py,md}`,
`results/s011/{runs.npz, summary.json, yield_vs_density.png,
q0_err_distribution.png}`, `results/s011_run.log` (gitignored).

What s011 does NOT decide:
- 100-seed cohort yield (only 10 measured).
- N=128/256 yield on seed 10 (whether the failure is N-recoverable).
- ω-grid scaling — held at truth-ω here.
- Hi-fi ρ-band classification of in-basin landings + competing basins.
  Surrogate-MSE ≠ ρ-band per `concepts/rho_band.md`.
