**s010 — seed-44 surrogate landscape probe at fixed truth-ω
(2026-04-30).** 2046 Sobol-Shoemake quaternions + truth + twin = 2048
candidates, SOBOL_SEED=42 (matches s002 / s006), Pool(8), BLAS=1,
wall 33.4 s. Decisive case (A) for the s009 seed-44 sub-question.

- **truth IS the global argmin** (truth_full_mse = 3.357e-4 mag²,
  matches s001 cache). s002's "argmin = truth on 8/8" universality
  survives extension to seed 44 — even though joint LM finds a
  competing basin from inside-tube ICs (s009), the competing basin
  is **invisible at 2046-Sobol density**.
- **n_sobol_below_truth = 0**, n_sobol_below_lm_mse = 0;
  competing-K counts (K=2/5/10/100) all 0/2046.
- **No Sobol point lies within 10° of the s009 T1 LM-landing q0**
  (rings [0,5)°: n=0; [5,10)°: n=0; [10,20)°: n=6 with mse_p10 =
  1.5 mag², ~25× above LM-landing's 0.06 mag²). Sobol_min_geo_to_lm =
  10.06° (same nearest-neighbour resolution as s006-on-seed-28's
  truth basin).
- **LM-landing is NOT a body-symmetry artefact.** geo to truth
  99.60°; closest rigid-body pole (180°y · truth) = 81.89°; twin
  (180°x · truth) = 177.68°; all other ±90° / 180° body poles ≥
  120°. The competing basin is a real (q0, ω)-jointly-coupled
  surrogate-MSE local minimum, not a near-twin / near-pole
  structural degeneracy. LM-ω matches truth-ω to <1%.
- The truth basin on seed 44 is also sub-Sobol-resolution
  (sobol_min_geo_to_truth = 16.35°; closest Sobol mse 0.59 mag²,
  ~1750× above truth_mse), consistent with seed 28 in s006.

Implications:
- **s002's argmin=truth claim and s009's competing-basin finding
  are compatible**, not contradictory. Bare Sobol(2046) at fixed
  truth-ω finds truth correctly on seed 44; the competing basin is
  a separate cost-surface feature LM polish discovers from
  specific IC axes.
- **Q4c-cohort architecture choice unaffected.** LM polish per
  candidate is doing the basin-finding; bare Sobol density is the
  initialisation only. Multi-axis Sobol(q0) on SO(3) (not body-X-
  perturbations) is necessary for cohort coverage of seeds 44/76 —
  some axes will polish into truth, others into the competing basin.
- Seed 44 joins seed 28 as a confirmed sub-Sobol-narrow-basin
  cohort member (now 2/100 measured at depth). Likely seed 76 has
  the same regime — single-seed s006-idiom probe (~30 s) would
  confirm.

Artefacts: `experiments/s010_seed44_landscape_at_truth_omega.{py,md}`,
`results/s010/{landscape.npz, summary.json, landscape.png,
lm_landing_ring.png}`, `results/s010_run.log` (gitignored).

What s010 does NOT decide:
- Whether seed 76 has the symmetric finding (case A) or differs.
- Hi-fi ρ-band classification of the LM-landing state (needs
  `lib/hifi_render.py`). 0.06 mag² surrogate MSE → likely Band-D
  but ρ-band is a hi-fi-LC measurement, not derivable from
  surrogate MSE alone.
- Whether the competing basin survives ω perturbation or is a
  knife-edge feature at exactly truth-ω (s003-style ω-misspec

- The mechanism: glint-multiplicity degeneracy, inertia-axis

**s009 — cohort basin-radius probe (Q4b extension) — STRONGLY
POSITIVE (2026-04-30).** 100 m048 seeds × 2 ICs (T1_inside q0=2°/
ωd=0.3°/ωm-1°; T3_edge q0=8°/ωd=1°/ωm-5%, both along deterministic
body-X axis) = 200 LM runs. Pool(8), BLAS=1, wall 564 s.

- **97/100 seeds pass T1 strict** (q0_err<5°, ωd_err<1°, |ωm_err|<5%).
  90/100 at q0_err<1°. Median q0_err=0.188°, p90=0.934°.
- **45/100 seeds pass T3 strict** (basin ≥8° in body-X axis).
- **Cohort basin classification**:
  - WIDE (≥8°): **45%** (45 seeds)
  - MID (2°-8°): **52%** (52 seeds)
  - TIGHT (<2°): **3%** — seeds 7, 44, 76
  - ANOMALOUS: 0%
- **Tight-tail decomposition (NEW finding):**
  - Seed 7: T1 lands just outside basin at q0_err=7.5°, ωd_err=5.9°,
    final_mse=1.85 mag² (near-miss / basin-edge stall).
  - Seeds 44 and 76: T1 lands in **competing q0 basin ~100° from
    truth at near-truth ω** with low final_mse (0.018-0.060 mag²),
    near-perfect ω recovery (ωd_err 0.1-0.8°, |ωm_err| <1.1%). These
    are real (q0, ω)-jointly-coupled competing basins, NOT stall
    points. This refines s002's "argmin=truth on 8/8 seeds" claim:
    not universal; ~2% of cohort has competing q0 attractors.
- Twin basin recoveries: 0/200 (consistent with s005 — twin not an
  attractor at near-truth ω).

Implications:
- **Q4c-on-bulk-cohort is feasible.** Partial-cohort acceptance
  (drop 3% tight tail) gives 97% recoverable from a coarse Sobol(q0)
  + LM polish strategy. Bulk cohort recoverable at ~10⁵ candidates
  per seed (uniform Sobol on SO(3) at 2° density); 45% recoverable
  at ~6e3 candidates (8° density).
- **Multi-axis Sobol(q0) is necessary** to handle the body-X-axis
  blind-spot at seeds 44 / 76 — single-axis perturbations miss this
  small subset. Sobol(q0) on SO(3) covers all axes uniformly.
- s002's argmin=truth property is approximately but not universally
  true. Sub-question Q2b opened: extend s002's 2046-Sobol probe to
  100 seeds at fixed truth-ω; ~50 min wall extrapolated.

Artefacts: `experiments/s009_cohort_basin_radius_probe.{py,md}`,
`results/s009/{runs.npz, summary.json, cohort_basins.png,
error_panels.png}`, `results/s009_run.log` (gitignored).

What s009 does NOT decide:
- Multi-axis basin shape — body-X axis is one slice; s006 showed
  basins are anisotropic. Extension: 100 seeds × 6 axes × 2 tiers
  (~30 min wall).
- Whether seeds 44 / 76 competing basins are a body-symmetry
  artefact (e.g. near-twin), a surrogate-MSE artefact, or a real
  cost-surface multi-basin pathology. Single-seed Sobol probe
  (s006 idiom) on seed 44 would clarify.
- Hi-fi ρ-band validation of converged states (still pending).
- Q4c-ii cohort run at chosen Sobol(q0) density — the natural
  follow-up.

**s008 — LC-feature regression for ω-magnitude (Q4c-iv) — DECISIVE
NEGATIVE (2026-04-30).** 100 m048 seeds × 28-dim LC feature vector
(top-5 LS peaks freq+power, mag stats, ACF lags, glint count/spacing)
× 4 regressors (linear / ridge / RF / GBR) × {direct, log} target,
leave-one-out cross-validation. Wall 60 s.

- **Best: GBR-log, median LOO MAPE = 16.4%** (worse than s007 oracle
  7.4%, far above s005's 3-5% basin radius bar).
- **Per-rotation subcohort** (gbr-log): <2 rot (n=10) median 22.8% /
  p90 91.5%; 2-3 rot (n=11) median 37.8% / p90 104%; 3-5 rot (n=13)
  median 20.0% / p90 61.8%; ≥5 rot (n=66) median 13.5% / p90 53.3%.
  Even the best subcohort has only 21% of seeds within 5%.
- **Worst seed: seed 91** with 14.3 rotations sampled but predicted as
  ω/4 (78.9% error). Confirms s007 finding that seed 91's LC is
  precession-envelope-dominated; both spectral and time-domain
  features inherit this bias and the regressor mis-learns.
- **Top-4 RF features:** ACF first-peak lag (0.281), ACF lag1 (0.102),
  ACF lag5 (0.101), glint count (0.100). The dominant feature
  IS the multi-periodicity-confused ACF lag — same structural problem
  s007 hit, now confirmed at scale across 100 seeds.
- **Mechanism:** the LC reflects body-frame trajectories of (k1, k2),
  which depend on q0 + ω + inertia ratios jointly. Without satellite-
  model knowledge of inertia ratios, LC features are jointly under-
  determined for ω.

Implications:
- **All LC-only ω priors closed:** s003 (no useful ω-gradient outside
  truth tube) + s007 (cheap spectral prior fails) + s008 (model-aware
  multi-feature regression fails) form a structural argument that the
  LC alone does not carry sufficient ω-magnitude information.
- **Q4c at cohort scale needs an architectural shift OR partial-cohort
  acceptance.** The remaining options are (a) brute-force ω-grid + LM
  at >>1 day per seed cost (infeasible cohort-wide), (b) accept that
  seed-28-class tight basins fail and target the wide-basin majority,
  or (c) move to hierarchical / adaptive search (basin-hopping,
  Bayesian opt) — design pending.

Artefacts: `experiments/s008_lc_feature_regression_omega.{py,md}`,
`results/s008/{features.npz, predictions.npz, summary.json,
scatter.png, feature_importance.png}`, `results/s008_run.log`.

What s008 does NOT decide:
- Whether deeper neural-net regression could close the gap. Unlikely
  to bridge 2-3× (16% → 5%) given the structural ceiling, but not
  measured.
- Whether ω-direction is similarly under-determined. Not measured (ω-
  dir stats targets weren't trained — would inherit the same problem).
- Cohort basin-radius distribution (still pending — would tell us
  what fraction of seeds Q4c can recover at a chosen density).

**s007 — peak-spacing ω-mag prior pilot (Q4c-iii) — DECISIVE NEGATIVE
(2026-04-30).** 10 PA/ω-stratified seeds (6/10/18/21/28/41/48/60/84/91)
× Lomb-Scargle on the truth hi-fi LC + ACF cross-check. Wall 0.06 s.

- **Blind dominant-peak estimator:** median error 15.7% on well-sampled
  subcohort (≥3 rotations, n=8). Worst case 72.3%. Far above s005's
  3-5% basin radius.
- **Oracle estimator (truth-aware best-of-top-5 × {1×, 2×} harmonics):**
  median 7.4%, worst 17.2%. Better, but still above the basin bar AND
  unattainable without truth knowledge.
- **ACF cross-check:** median 22.6%, much worse than LS oracle.
- **Peak-frequency ratios scatter 0.14×-6.7× of truth ω across seeds**;
  no consistent 1× / 2× / sub-harmonic structure. The dominant LS peak
  is sometimes the rotation rate (seeds 28, 60), sometimes 2× (seeds
  6, 21), sometimes a small fraction (seeds 41, 91 at ~0.28 ≈ 1/4 —
  consistent with precession-driven envelope dominating over spin).
- **Mechanism:** tumbling-rigid-body LCs are multi-periodic (precession
  + spin + their beats and BRDF harmonics). The LC's spectral content
  does not directly encode |ω| because the periodicities are coupled
  to inertia ratios, not just rotation rate.

Implications:
- **Q4c-iii is closed.** Cheap LC-spectral priors cannot bootstrap
  ω-mag within s005's basin radius.
- Q4c is harder than the PROGRESS hypothesis assumed — the path now
  requires either a coarse ω-mag grid (≳30 points) or a model-aware
  prior (Q4c-iv, NEW). Naive 6D Sobol+LM at the seed-28-calibrated
  density (1.2e10 candidates per seed) is infeasible.

Artefacts: `experiments/s007_omega_mag_peak_spacing_pilot.{py,md}`,
`results/s007/{peakspacing.npz, summary.json, periodograms.png,
truth_vs_estimate.png}`, `results/s007_run.log`.

What s007 does NOT decide:
- Whether time-domain features (glint count, glint spacing, mean LC
  brightness) carry independent ω information beyond the periodogram.
- Whether a regression model trained on the 100 m048 truth LCs can
  exploit feature combinations the simple peak-spacing hides.
- Cohort-scale failure-mode distribution (the 10-seed pilot is enough
  to close Q4c-iii but not to characterise per-seed failure modes).

**s006 — seed-28 surrogate-MSE landscape at fixed truth-ω (2026-04-30).**
2046 Sobol-Shoemake quaternions + truth + twin = 2048 candidates on seed 28
(SOBOL_SEED=42 matching s002; Pool(8), BLAS=1, wall 28.7 s).

- **Decisive case (A): single-basin, narrow-basin landscape.** argmin = truth
  (full_mse 5.85e-4 mag², matches s001 / s005 truth-MSE reference exactly).
- **n_sobol_below_K × truth_mse = 0 for K ∈ {1, 2, 5, 10, 100}.** The entire
  Sobol cloud sits at least **1456× above truth_mse**.
- **sobol_min_geo_to_truth = 10.06°** (s002 range was 4.2°-12.4°; seed 28 at
  upper end). best_sobol_mse = 0.851 mag² @ 12.24° geo.
- **Sobol MSE distribution is unimodal on a high plateau** (median 11.07 mag²,
  p10 7.52, p90 15.55). No second mode → no Sobol-visible competing basin.
- **s005 LM escapes (7 ICs landing at q0_err 20°-113°, final MSE 5.12-9.15
  mag²) sit squarely inside the Sobol p10-p90 high-MSE band — they are
  LM-stall points in the broad plateau, NOT competing-basin attractors.**
- s004's seed-28 alignment-cost multi-basin pathology (2 Sobol below truth at
  baseline ω, argmin 176.8° from truth) does **not** carry over to surrogate-
  MSE on seed 28. The cost surface choice matters; surrogate-MSE on seed 28
  is structurally cleaner than alignment cost on the same seed.

Implications for Q4c (calibration target):
- Seed 28's 2° basin is **sub-Sobol-resolution at 2046 points**. Closest
  Sobol approach (10°) is ≫ basin radius (2°), so even Sobol+LM fails on
  seed 28 unless polish entry sits inside the basin.
- Naive density estimate: q0 basin volume on SO(3) ≈ 1.6e-5 → ~6e4 uniform
  candidates per seed for one in-basin hit. Cohort scale → 6e6 with naive
  sampling. Confirms the **ω-mag-from-peak-spacing prior** (Q4c-iii) is
  the most promising path to make Q4c tractable.
- LM-polish-per-Sobol-candidate is mandatory, but insufficient on seed
  28-class basins at 2046 density. Need either ≥10² × density on q0 or
  conditioning to drop dimensions.

Artefacts: `experiments/s006_seed28_landscape_at_truth_omega.{py,md}`,
`results/s006/{landscape.npz, summary.json, landscape.png, competing_basins.png}`,
`results/s006_run.log`.

What s006 does NOT decide:
- Whether seed 28's basin is representative of the cohort tail (only 1 seed
  probed at this depth; cohort-scale basin-radius probe is on the Q4c roadmap).
- Sub-10° landscape structure (between Sobol resolution and the 2° basin
  measurement). Possible but unmotivated by s005's escape data.
- ω-misspecified surrogate landscape on seed 28 (s003 sampled 6/41/91, not 28).

**s005 — joint (q0, ω) Levenberg-Marquardt local descent (2026-04-30).**
5 seeds (6 / 18 / 28 / 41 / 91) × 10 ICs each (6 deterministic tiers + 4
random inside-tube) = 50 LM runs. Pool(8), BLAS=1, total wall 215 s.

- **Joint LM converges from inside the tube on 4/5 seeds:**
  | tier        | q0 IC | ωd IC | ωm IC | strict converged |
  |-------------|-------|-------|-------|------------------|
  | T1_inside   | 2°    | 0.3°  | -1%   | **5/5**          |
  | T2_inside   | 5°    | 0.5°  | -3%   | **4/5** (seed 28 fails) |
  | T3_edge     | 8°    | 1°    | -5%   | 2/5              |
  | T4_outside  | 15°   | 2°    | -8%   | 1/5              |
  | T5_outside  | 30°   | 4°    | -12%  | 0/5              |
  | T6_outside  | 60°   | 8°    | -20%  | 0/5              |
  | random in-tube | 0-5°    | 0-1°  | ±3%   | **18/20 (90%)** |
- **Bimodal convergence:** when LM succeeds, q0_err<1°, ω_dir_err<0.05°,
  |ω_mag_err|<0.01% and final surrogate-MSE matches cached s001 truth-MSE
  within 1-9% (slightly deeper local minimum — surrogate intrinsic noise,
  not a competing basin). When LM fails, q0_err jumps to 20°-180° and
  MSE explodes to 0.1-9 mag². No intermediate outcomes.
- **Per-seed basin radius (largest deterministic tier with strict
  convergence):**
  - seed 6:  **wide** (~15° in q0; T4 still converges)
  - seed 18: **mid** (~5° in q0; T3 fails)
  - seed 28: **tight** (~2° in q0; T2 already fails; 2/4 random in-tube
    fails — the s004 alignment-cost multi-basin pathology carries over
    to surrogate-MSE)
  - seed 41: **mid** (~8° in q0; T3 succeeds, T4 fails)
  - seed 91: **mid** (~5° in q0; T3 fails)
- **Twin basin recoveries: 0/50.** Twin (q_180x · q0_truth, same ω) is
  not an attractor at near-truth ω.
- **Seed 91 (m115 anchor) recovered from inside the tube on 6/6
  inside-tube ICs.** The m115 failure is fully decomposed: outer-ω-search
  structural (s003) + local-descent works at near-truth ω (s005).

Strategic decision: **joint (q0, ω) LM is the viable inversion architecture.**
Q4a (inside-tube convergence) and Q4b (basin radii) are settled. The
remaining load-bearing question is Q4c — what global-search density is
needed to seed the polish with at least one in-basin candidate per seed.

Cell counts (50 = 5 seeds × 10 ICs) for s005:
- truth basin (strict): 30/50 (60%)
- truth basin (loose, 10°/2°/10%): 30/50 (identical — bimodal)
- twin basin: 0/50
- failed (q0_err ≥ 10° or ω errors out of band): 20/50 (40%)

Artefacts: `experiments/s005_joint_local_descent.{py,md}`,
`results/s005/{runs.npz, summary.json, convergence.png, error_panels.png}`,
`results/s005_run.log`.

What s005 does NOT decide:
- Hi-fi ρ-band validation of the converged candidates (deferred to
  follow-up; `lib/hifi_render.py` is still a stub).
- Cohort-scale convergence (only 5 seeds tested; including 1 known
  pathology seed and 4 nominal seeds).
- Global-search density required to seed the polish (Q4c).
- Whether seed 28's pathology is q0-landscape-only or also ω-coupled.
- Anisotropy of the basin in (q0_axis, ω-dir-axis) space (single
  perpendicular axes per seed for det tiers; 4 random axes per seed
  via the random ICs, but small sample).

## Next

**s032+s033+s034 done (2026-05-05) — basin recovered on seed 89 via density+polish chain.** The s031 negative on seed 6 has been reframed as a bracket-subsampling artefact (s032 cohort showed 4/79 within 5%, vs s019's 98/100 on full grid). With the bracket-padding fix (s033), N_dir=2000+N_mag=20 closes q0 to 8.59°, and LM polish (s034) bridges the residual to 0.86° from truth (surrogate Band A, predicted ρ=0.37, 24/50 polished into Band A).

**Highest-priority next step (~1 min compute):**

1. **Hi-fi confirmation of the s034 surrogate-Band-A candidates.** Render the 24 polished candidates with `lib.hifi_render.build_context(89)` + `render_lc()`, compute hi-fi ρ vs truth. Per s017, expect surrogate ρ=0.37 → hi-fi ρ≈1-2 (still Band A∪B). If confirmed, the framework is **end-to-end validated on seed 89**. Pool(8) fork-context, BLAS=1, ~9s/render = ~1 min wall.

**Then (in priority order):**

2. **Multi-seed generalisation pilot (~30 min compute).** Run the density+polish chain on 3-5 cohort-representative seeds: one zero-survivor seed from s032 (e.g., seed 23 with nearest_cell=5.6%, a "good bracket" zero-survivor); one high-survivor seed from s032 (e.g., seed 57 with 19,847 survivors); and one mid-bracket seed (e.g., seed 28 with nearest_cell=7.9%). Tests whether seed 89 was favorable or representative.

3. **Cohort-scale density+polish run (4-5 days).** If multi-seed pilot is positive, dispatch the full 78 OK seeds at N_dir=2000+N_mag=20+phi=12 → top-50 LM polish per seed. Wall budget per seed-89 ~10 min × 78 = 13 hr nominal; 5× outlier slowdown → ~3-4 days. Disk ~30 GB.

4. **Re-run failed cohort seeds 0 and 3** (bug fix in place; ~2 min each) for completeness of s032 cohort.

5. **Out-of-bracket seeds (72, 91, 97).** s032 confirmed seed 72 (truth below bracket lo) and seed 97 (truth ABOVE bracket hi at 103%) are structurally outside the LS-bracket. Need a bracket-extension strategy (or accept as cohort tail).

**Closed dead-ends after this session:**

- The s031 "framework structurally constrained" reading was a subsampling artefact, not a framework property. The bracket-padding fix + LM polish recovers the basin on seed 89 in 10 min wall.
- Phi densification past 30° spacing does NOT close q0 (s033 verified: 12→60 phi gives only 9% improvement). The off-circle floor (~7-8°) is geometric and requires LM polish (s034) to bridge.

**Strategic landmark:** end-to-end framework validation on seed 89 in surrogate is the first positive end-to-end result of the survey workspace. Hi-fi confirmation is the gating test before generalisation.

### Older "Next" plan (s030/s031 era), retained for context

The s030/s031 forward paths (1-5) listed below are SUPERSEDED by the s032/s033/s034 chain. Items 2 (densify bracket) and 3 (LM polish) were the correct calls, and have been validated by s033/s034 on seed 89. Item 4 (cohort-class evidence) was implicitly delivered by s032.

1. **Switch IC primitive at ω-cell-0** (Sobol-Shoemake on q0 inside the bracket bin) — untested post-fix; doesn't fix tube boundary.
2. **Densify the bracket** (push from 5 LS peaks to ±1% steps within LS-peak neighborhood) — VALIDATED in s033; the geometric-grid padding extension was the correct fix.
3. **Joint q0×ω LM at every IC** (filter as ranking heuristic only) — VALIDATED in s034 on top-50 candidates (not all ICs); bridges the off-circle floor.
4. **Accept seed 6 as cohort-class evidence** (cohort-wide s019b tube-coverage + s003 tube-width measurement → identify recoverable subset) — DELIVERED by s032; cohort coverage 4/79 within 5%, motivating the bracket-padding fix.
5. **Multi-solution fallback** — still unviable on seed 6 specifically; potentially viable on other seeds where multi-solution attractors exist (per s014).

   coarse-ω pilot.

### Earlier framing (s017 verdict, retained for context)

**s017 done — multi-solution reframe rejected (3/7 winners Band A∪B;
threshold ≥4/7).** Joint-search architecture as configured delivers
only 43% production-quality on the pilot; cohort production blocked.
The previously-pegged architectural pivot was S016-A (ω-grid stratification +
per-cell q0-Sobol). Plan, in priority order:

1. **s018 — S016-A coarse pass-1 architecture pilot (PRIMARY, BLOCKING).**
   Design + 2-3-seed pilot. Architecture sketch:
   - **Pass 1 grid:** 30° ω-dir spacing (Fibonacci ~50 cells on S²)
     × 0.2 dps ω-mag spacing (~8 cells over [0.1, 1.5] dps) = ~400 cells.
   - **Per cell:** Sobol-Shoemake(q0) at N=16 or 32 + 6-DOF LM polish
     (max_nfev=60). Cohort-selector = lowest surrogate MSE in cell;
     s016c_prime found Sobol(q0)+Sobol(ω-dir) at N=64 per cell finds
     truth-q0 IF the cell contains truth-ω, but doesn't bridge across
     cells. Pass-1 just locates the truth-ω cell.
   - **Per seed cost:** 400 cells × 32 ICs = 12800 LM runs ≈ 8 hr Pool(8)
     pass-1. Pass-2 refinement (~4 hr) on 5-10% best cells.
   - **Pilot seeds (recommend 3):**
     - **seed 28** — worst-case calibration (failed at PERFECT ω-mag
       in s016c_prime; tests whether finer ω-grid + smaller per-cell
       Sobol bridges the s006-narrow basin).
     - **seed 91** — high-n_rot validator (s011 truth-ω recoverable;
       s017 joint-search Band C; tests whether S016-A bridges).
     - **seed 6** — easier control (s011 truth-ω recoverable with 8/64
       in-basin; s017 joint-search Band D; tests architecture sanity).
   - **Total pilot wall:** 24-36 hr Pool(8). Multi-day; needs careful
     checkpointing (per-cell NPZ + JSON every ~20 cells).
   - **Decisive question:** does S016-A pass-1 land at least one ρ<4
     candidate per pilot seed? If yes → architecture viable; design
     full cohort scan. If no → all known architectures broken; need to
     rethink (basin-hopping, surrogate retraining at off-truth-ω,
     fundamental rethink of LC-information-content limits).

2. **(Optional) S017-density consolation.** Re-run s016c_prime at
   N=512 per harvest. ~6 hr Pool(8). Tests whether seeds 6 / 91 are
   density-recoverable WITHOUT structural pivot. Doesn't address seed 28
   (s006-structural) or seed 49 (bad ω-mag harvest). Lower information
   value than s018; defer until s018 result is in.

3. **(Optional) Hi-fi ρ-band of all 960 s016c_prime LM landings.**
   Cohort-architecture trust extension. ~12 min Pool(8). Would extend
   the s017 hi-fi/surrogate ratio measurement (n=21) to a larger
   cohort and confirm whether the [0.983, 1.027] widening generalises.
   Defer; not load-bearing.

4. **(Cancelled / demoted)** S016-B (LC-feature ω-mag bias). Mostly
   dead — addresses only ω-mag axis, which we just showed is
   insufficient even at perfect value (seed 28 in s016c_prime).

5. **(Cancelled / demoted)** Truth-ω cohort scan (formerly "s012").
   Joint search closure makes it not load-bearing for production.

**Closed strategic questions (s015 + s016 + s016c_prime + s017):**
- "Does the multi-solution reframe rescue the joint-search architecture?"
  Answer: **NO.** 3/7 pilot seeds achieve Band A∪B, threshold was ≥4/7.
- "Is the surrogate ↔ hi-fi MSE ratio at off-truth-ω as tight as at
  truth-ω?" Answer: **NO, 3-5× wider.** Per-seed argmin order
  preserved; absolute MSE bias is ±3-5% not ±1%.
- "Does seed 28 have any reachable low-MSE basin (truth or
  multi-solution) at PERFECT ω-mag and joint Sobol(q0×ω-dir) at N=64?"
  Answer: **NO.** Both basin and best multi-solution at ρ ≥ 46.
- "Are class_2/class_3 multi-solution attractors restricted to low
  n_rot?" Answer: **NO** — seed 91 (n_rot=14.3) has class_2 attractor
  at Band C under joint search.

### Older "Next" (pre-s015), retained for context:

**s014b done — n_rotations is the dominant cohort-tail predictor;
multi-solution structure is class_1+class_2+class_3 with the
near-180°-flip class_3 a structural finding.** The two cached-data
follow-ups recommended after s014 are now both closed. **The next
load-bearing experiment adds the ω axis.** Plan, in priority order:

1. **s015 — joint q0 × ω inversion pilot (phase 3 onramp).** Extend
   s011's q0-Sobol(64) at truth-ω to a joint (q0, ω) IC distribution
   that does NOT assume truth-ω. Three candidate designs to choose
   from (decision before launching):
   - **(a) Sobol-q0(64) × ω-grid(5×5).** 25 ω-cells spanning the
     s003-measured tube (~ ±2° dir × ±10% mag). 1600 LM runs/seed
     × 5-10 pilot seeds × ~25 s wall = ~5-10 h Pool(8).
   - **(b) Joint Sobol-(q0, ω).** Single Sobol cloud sampling the
     6-D (q0, ω) joint space at some density N. Drops the grid
     decoupling; same architecture as s011 but with ω jittered.
   - **(c) Adaptive ω refinement.** q0-Sobol(64) at coarse ω-grid
     (3×3); refine ω-grid only where Sobol(q0)+LM lands within tube
     proximity at the coarse grid. Lower expected wall, harder to
     specify.
   Validation cohort: **reuse s011's 9 recoverable seeds for direct
   comparison + 2-3 of the s014b-predicted n_rot<2 cohort tail**
   (candidates 13 / 42 / 79 — different mean PA bands within the
   low-rot subset for orthogonal coverage). **Decisive question:** can
   a joint (q0, ω) global-search architecture, with NO truth-ω given,
   recover Band A∪B candidates on the same 9-seed cohort that s011
   recovered at truth-ω, AND on the n_rot<2 calibration seeds?
   **Open survey-bar question to settle BEFORE s015 launches:** keep
   ρ<4 acceptance bar (s014b admits 9/9 multi-solution clusters) or
   tighten to ρ<3.5 (flips seed 10 + seed 84 q0=179.6° cluster to
   FAILURE)?
2. **(Optional) Truth-ω cohort scan (formerly "s012").** 6400 LM runs,
   ~6.5 h Pool(8). Diagnostic insurance only — answers "does the
   q0-axis architecture extend cleanly to all 100 seeds?" before phase 3
   adds ω-search complexity. **NOT load-bearing for full inversion;**
   any phase-3 joint scan that includes a truth-ω cell recovers it for
   free. Run only if a long-tail surprise from s015 motivates
   decoupling diagnosis. The s014b predicted-failure list (10 seeds
   n_rot<2) gives a focused subcohort: ~50 min Pool(8) on those 10
   seeds × N=64 alone is a cheap pre-s015 check if appetite exists.
3. **(Optional) Class_3 mechanism probe.** Render hi-fi LCs from each
   of the 5 class_3 attractors + visualise body-frame trajectory of
   k1/k2 + which facets reflect at each attitude vs truth. ~5-10 min
   Pool(8). Distinguishes (a) m048-geometry near-symmetry from
   (b) surrogate-LM polish artefact from (c) LC-similarity coincidence
   at low-info LCs. Useful framing input for survey writeup; does NOT
   gate s015.
4. **N=512 stress test on seed 10 / s012b basin-hopping.** LOW priority
   post-s014b (multi-solution accepted; mechanism story is now
   coherent). Defer until full-inversion architecture decisions are
   made.

**Recommendation:** **Move directly to option 1 (s015 design)** —
n_rotations + multi-solution analyses are now closed (s014b);
all analytical questions PROGRESS recommended first have been
addressed. Decision before launching s015: pick architecture
(a/b/c), seed list (s011 recoverable 9 + 2-3 from n_rot<2 cohort
tail), and acceptance bar (ρ<4 vs ρ<3.5).

## Open survey questions (sequenced)

1. **Q1 — cost-at-truth, cohort-scale** ✅ (s001).
2. **Q2 — surrogate landscape probe (fixed truth-ω)** ✅ (s002).
3. **Q3 — surrogate landscape under ω-misspecification** ✅ (s003).
   Decisive: extremely narrow truth-ω tube; surrogate-MSE-decoupled
   architectures dead.
4. **Q5 — m103 alignment-cost ω-fragility** ✅ (s004). Decisive:
   alignment cost strictly worse than surrogate-MSE; all decoupled
   (ω-outer / q0-inner) architectures dead. Joint local descent is
   the only path forward.
5. **Q4a — inside-tube joint LM convergence** ✅ (s005). Decisive:
   converges to truth basin on 4/5 PA-stratified seeds and 18/20
   random in-tube ICs.
6. **Q4b — basin-of-attraction radius** ✅ (s005). Seed-dependent:
   2-15° in q0_geodesic, ~1-2° in ω-dir, ~3-5% in ω-mag.
7. **Q4d — seed 28 surrogate landscape probe** ✅ (s006). Decisive
   case (A): single-basin, narrow-basin (sub-Sobol-resolution at
   2046 points). LM escapes are stall points, not competing-basin
   attractors. Confirms seed 28 is the worst-case calibration target
   for Q4c.
8. **Q4c-iii — peak-spacing ω-mag prior** ❌ (s007). Decisive negative:
   LC multi-periodicity prevents simple spectral priors from matching
   ω-mag within s005's basin radius. Cheap LC-feature priors hit a
   structural wall.
9. **Q4c-iv — model-aware ω regression** ❌ (s008). Decisive negative:
   28-feature multi-model LOO regression on 100 seeds achieves best
   16.4% median MAPE; LC-only priors closed structurally.
10. **Cohort basin-radius probe (Q4b extension)** ✅ (s009). 100 seeds
    × 2 ICs along body-X axis: 97% pass T1 (basin ≥2°), 45% pass T3
    (basin ≥8°), 3 tight-tail seeds (7, 44, 76). New finding: seeds 44
    and 76 have competing q0 basins ~100° from truth at near-truth ω.
11. **Seed-44 single-seed Sobol probe** ✅ (s010). Decisive case (A):
    competing basin is sub-Sobol-resolution at 2046 density. s002's
    argmin=truth claim survives.
12. **Q4c-ii cohort pilot, q0 axis** ✅ (s011). 9/10 pilot seeds at
    N=64 → DECISION: Sobol-q0 cheap; Q4c works at low density.
    Discovery: LM has basin-grab radius far larger than the basin
    itself (sub-Sobol-narrow basins still get 5-7/64 in-basin
    landings). New finding: seed 10 is multi-axis tight-tail
    (s009 body-X under-counted the cohort fail rate).
13. **s012a — seed-10 single-seed N=256 probe** ✅. DECISIVE H2
    (2026-05-01). 0/256 in-basin at any cumulative density (N=64,
    128, 256); closest LM landing 28°→13° but never bridges; competing
    basins 49→76→123 sub-linear. **Q4c at fixed truth-ω fails on
    seed-10-class for any feasible Sobol density.** Mechanism:
    1.055 rotations sampled → LC under-determines (q0, ω). Strategic
    next move: hi-fi ρ-band classification (s013) to decide
    multi-solution-acceptance vs genuine-failure interpretation.
14. **`survey/lib/hifi_render.py` — copy-adapt + smoke-test.** ✅
    (s013, 2026-05-01). Built from `notebooks/inversion/lib/lc_compare.py:
    generate_hifi_lc` (reference) using survey-local `lib/traj_load.py`
    + `src.*` substrate. Smoke test on seeds 6/10/91 reproduces cached
    `mag_hifi` to bit-identical (max|Δ|=0). Pool-safe with explicit
    `torch.set_num_threads(1)` per the s011 fix.
15. **s013 — hi-fi ρ-band classification.** ✅ (2026-05-01).
    DECISION: **MULTI_SOLUTION at the boundary.** Cohort A (36 s011
    in-basin landings): all Band A (ρ ≤ 0.230). Cohort B (256 seed-10
